jobs.title: 5-Axis CNC Manufacturing Process Engineer
jobs.description: **Shape how complex parts come to life** ---------------------------------------- Step into a high\-mix, low\-volume environment where precision, agility, and creativity intersect. As our 5\-Axis CNC Manufacturing Process Engineer, you’ll own process development from CAD/CAM strategy through shop\-floor execution—combining world\-class Mastercam programming with practical automation to boost throughput and repeatability. ### **A day in this role** * **Morning:** Review new part designs, select tooling/fixturing, and craft optimized 5\-axis toolpaths in Mastercam. Validate with simulation and G\-code reviews. * **Midday:** Partner with design, production, and automation teams to de\-risk manufacturability, troubleshoot setups, and refine programs for cycle time and surface quality. * **Afternoon:** Stand up or tune automation (pallets/robots/probing) to elevate flexibility and throughput. Document workflows and NC strategies for repeat builds. * **Always:** Lead lean/Six Sigma improvements, uphold safety, quality, and environmental standards, and mentor peers on best practices. ### **What you’ll tackle** * Optimize processes for complex geometries and materials in a high\-mix, low\-volume setting. * Program and debug 5\-axis CNC machines using Mastercam; post, prove\-out, and refine G\-code. * Design and implement automation to increase flexibility and throughput. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to resolve manufacturing challenges quickly and sustainably. * Drive continuous improvement using lean and Six Sigma methodologies. * Create clear documentation for machining processes, NC programs, and automation workflows. * Ensure full compliance with safety, quality, and environmental requirements. ### **What you’ll bring** * Extensive experience in high\-mix, low\-volume machining environments. * **Deep expertise in 5\-axis CNC programming and operations.** * Hands\-on success integrating automation into manufacturing processes. * Proficiency with CAD/CAM and G\-code; Mastercam mastery is a plus. * Excellent problem\-solving, project management, and communication skills. * Bachelor’s in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or related field (preferred). ### **What you’ll get** * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. * Opportunities to innovate and lead in a cutting\-edge manufacturing environment. * A dynamic, collaborative team culture. * Continuous learning and professional development. ### **Benefits** * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance * Paid time off * Referral program ### **Tools \& technologies** * CAM Software (Mastercam) * CNC Lathe (5\+ axis) ### **Core proficiency** CNC Programming

jobs.title: CFD Engineer - AI Simulation Output Review (Remote)
jobs.description: CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. jobs.title: Field Application Engineer
jobs.description: Overview Arete Intelligent Power builds the power conversion hardware behind high\-density AI compute. We are looking for a Field Application Engineer to be the technical authority on our rack\-level power portfolio: sidecar power racks, in\-rack AC\-DC and DC\-DC power supplies, and battery backup shelves. This is not facility infrastructure work. It is rack and component level, and it sits between hard power electronics and the customer's buying decision. What you'll do * Partner with the sales team to uncover technical requirements and architect rack\-level power conversion solutions for hyperscale and AI\-focused environments. * Develop conceptual designs, integration guidelines, and technical evaluations for sidecar power racks, high\-efficiency PSUs, and in\-rack DC\-DC conversion. * Lead technical responses to RFPs and RFQs; evaluate power shelves, BBU shelves, and DC\-DC modules for fit, derating, thermal envelope, and integration risk. * Represent Arete in OCP working groups and at the OCP Global Summit; guide customers on ORv3 and OCP HPR (21\-inch, 44 OU) form\-factor fit. * Field customer and AHJ questions on NEC 645, UL 62368, DC arc\-flash and IEEE 1584 analysis, and DC protection at 800 VDC. * Work daily with our Taiwan\-based R\&D organization to translate customer requirements into engineering\-ready requests. * Act as the voice of the customer for internal product and engineering teams, shaping future 800 VDC architectures. * Support bench testing and prototype validation with hardware engineering teams and system integrators. What you bring * BSEE or a closely related technical degree with a focus on power electronics. * 5\+ years in technical applications, sales support, or power engineering, working with server\-level power supplies and power conversion systems. * Deep proficiency in AC and DC power topologies, with strong emphasis on 800 VDC architectures and high\-density DC\-DC/AC\-DC conversion. * Working knowledge of Open Compute Project rack and power specifications (ORv3, OCP HPR) and the safety and certification framework governing data center power: NEC 645, UL 62368, IEEE 1584\. * Strong analytical understanding of power electronics components, including inverters, capacitors, and transformers in high\-heat, high\-load environments. * Exceptional communication skills, with a track record of guiding both hardware engineers and executive stakeholders through complex technical evaluations. * Comfort operating across time zones and cultures, including regular early\-morning coordination with engineering teams in Taiwan and periodic international travel. Details Full\-time, exempt. Onsite in Fremont, CA with flexibility around the early\-morning engineering cadence. Approximately 20% travel, domestic and international. Medical, dental and vision insurance, and seven days of paid time off annually. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Arete Intelligent Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, reproductive health decisionmaking, marital status, age (40 and over), national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Pay: $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Describe your hands\-on experience with 800 VDC or other high\-voltage DC power architectures. * Which Open Compute Project specifications have you worked with directly (for example ORv3 or OCP HPR), and in what capacity? * This role requires regular early\-morning video calls with our engineering team in Taiwan. Are you able to work that schedule? * Have you participated in OCP working groups or attended the OCP Global Summit? If so, please describe your involvement. Experience: * server\-level power supply or power conversion systems: 5 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 25% (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description: **About CroJack** CroJack is a privately held group operating across North America and as of 2026 Europe. The group is a private, relationship\-driven inventory solutions company connecting leading consumer brands with a curated network of vetted buyers worldwide. We currently operate four active entities across Canada and the U.S., Barbados, with a UK entity and a Malta entity coming online. Books are maintained in Canadian and U.S. dollars, consolidated in USD, with GBP and EUR reporting added as the European structure goes live. The business is intercompany\-heavy by design: capital and trade flows move between entities continuously. The group operates in English across every jurisdiction, including with its overseas partners. This is a build role, not a maintenance role. The accounting function is being professionalized at the same time the group is expanding internationally, and the Controller is the person who owns that build. **The Role** The Controller owns the accounting close, the consolidation, and the integrity of the numbers across every entity in the group. You will be the senior accounting authority in\-house, reporting to the CEO. The work sits at the intersection of three things that rarely show up together: **modern finance technology, multientity and multi\-currency consolidation and treasury, and physical cross\-border trade.** If you have done all three, this role is built for you. **The Path** This is a succession plan, not a job posting with a growth paragraph attached. CroJack runs its CFO function fractionally today, and that has been the right structure for a company this size. It will not be the right structure forever. As the European entities come online, the reporting layer matures, and the group's financial operations consolidate onto a single platform, CroJack will need a full\-time CFO in\-house. The intent is that it is you. The fractional CFO is not protecting that seat. The engagement is deliberately structured to transfer it — scope handed over in a planned sequence, with the parts you have not done yet taught rather than withheld. That is what a fractional CFO is for at this stage of a company's life: build the function, build the person who runs it, and step out. We are not naming a date, because the date depends on how fast the group grows and how fast you take the work. We are telling you the seat is the destination and the handoff is the plan. If you are a Controller who has outgrown a maintenance seat and wants the exposure that actually builds a CFO — capital, lenders, structure, and commercial judgment, not just a clean close — this is that seat. **How the Handoff Works** **• Phase one — you own the engine.** Close, consolidation, intercompany, compliance, and the systems build are yours. The fractional CFO holds treasury strategy, the lender relationship, and structuring work — and you are in every one of those conversations from day one. **• Phase two — you take the external seat.** Lender relationship, ownership and board\-level reporting, capital and working capital decisions, and commercial input transfer to you. The fractional CFO moves to advisory. **• Phase three — you hold the scope.** You are CroJack's CFO. The fractional engagement winds down to project support, or ends. Each phase carries a corresponding step in compensation and title. The scope moves first; the recognition follows it, and it is not left to be renegotiated from scratch. **What This Seat Gives You** * Direct ownership of the lender relationship and the credit facility — you build the reporting, you sit in the conversations * Ownership\-level reporting: you present the numbers and answer for them, rather than handing a package upward * Entity formation and cross\-border structuring as the UK, Malta, and Barbados entities come online, including the transfer pricing and compliance architecture that goes with them * Working capital and capital allocation decisions — deal funding, counterparty terms, and prepayment exposure are real capital decisions in this business * Commercial input: margin by deal, channel, and counterparty, and pricing conversations informed by true landed cost * Full ownership of the financial tech stack business case — build it, defend it to ownership, and own the outcome * A fractional CFO whose explicit mandate is to hand you the role — direct mentorship, with scope transferred in a planned sequence rather than absorbed by accident **What You'll Own** **Close, Consolidation, and Reporting** * Own the monthly close across all group entities — Canadian, U.S., Barbados, and European — and deliver a consolidated reporting package on a predictable calendar * Produce consolidated financial statements in USD, with currency translation performed against a published, internationally recognized rate source and a documented, defensible FX policy * Prepare entity\-level and consolidated P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow, with variance commentary the CEO can act on * Build and transferred. You are CroJack's CFO, and the fractional engagement has done what it was built to do **What We're Looking For** **Required** * CPA designation (Ordre des CPA du Québec, or CPA Canada with Quebec recognition), or an equivalent international designation recognized in Quebec * 7\+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3\+ years at a Controller or Assistant Controller level * Demonstrated multi\-entity consolidation experience — you have personally owned a consolidation, not just contributed schedules to one * Multi\-currency accounting experience, including translation methodology, FX gain/loss treatment, and consolidating entities with different functional currencies * International trade or import/export accounting experience — landed cost, duty and tariff treatment, customs documentation, incoterms, and inventory costing on imported goods * Intercompany accounting experience across jurisdictions: loans, allocations, settlements, and eliminations * Canadian compliance fluency: GST/HST and QST filing, CRA and Revenu Québec correspondence, and preparing clean, tie\-out\-ready support for external tax advisors * Systems\-forward — you have personally selected, implemented, or rebuilt a finance tech stack, and can point to close time or headcount you took out of the process, not just software you bought * Advanced Excel — you build models, not just fill in templates * The judgment and directness to tell ownership when a number is wrong, and the documentation to back it up **Strongly Preferred** * Consumer products, toy, apparel, CPG, or another physical\-goods importing business * Cross\-border U.S./Canada accounting, including U.S. state filing exposure * UK or EU experience — VAT, statutory filing requirements, or entity setup * ERP implementation experience, particularly a migration from small\-business accounting software to a true multi\-entity platform * Licensing or royalty accounting * Experience in an owner\-operated or founder\-led company, where the Controller is expected to solve problems rather than escalate them * Transfer pricing exposure **How You Work** * You are comfortable being the most senior accounting person in the room and the one who is accountable when the numbers are questioned * You would rather build the process once, properly, than patch it every month * You can move between a customs invoice, an intercompany loan schedule, and a conversation with the CEO about cash without losing the thread * You are direct, and you do not soften a material issue to keep a meeting comfortable * You want the CFO seat and can articulate specifically what you still need to learn to hold it — self\-awareness about the gap matters more to us than a polished claim that there isn't one * You can learn from someone whose job is to make themselves unnecessary to you, and you will ask for the handoff rather than wait to be offered it * You are comfortable in a growing, owner\-operated business where the scope expands faster than the org chart does **Compensation** * Base salary: CAD $110,000 to $130,000 commensurate with experience * Compensation reviewed at each phase of the handoff — the step in scope carries a step in pay and title, agreed in principle at hire rather than renegotiated later * Performance bonus tied to close quality, compliance calendar integrity, and tech implementation milestones * Fully remote, based in Montreal **To Apply** Send a resume and a short note covering three things: the most complex consolidation you have personally owned, a specific example of an international trade or landed cost issue you identified and fixed, and the part of the CFO role you feel least ready for today. Applications to holly@crojack.com We review on a rolling basis. CroJack is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and provide accommodation on request throughout the recruitment process. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer
jobs.description: Our client is an AI consulting and implementation company working exclusively within the Direct Selling industry. They help businesses move from AI curiosity to real AI capability by working closely with leadership teams. Their focus is on implementing practical AI solutions while building the tools, governance, and internal confidence clients need to continue progressing independently. They are looking for an **AI Agents \& Automations Engineer** with strong engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-ready AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different AI agent and automation frameworks and understands the importance of reliability, integrations, monitoring, error handling, and maintainability. The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Build the infrastructure around agents, including triggers, queues, error handling, retries, fallbacks and monitoring; * Define the access and infrastructure requirements for each solution, including credentials, permissions, data access, rate limits, service accounts and audit trails; * Design appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop processes where full automation is not suitable. **Agentic AI \& automation:** * Build solutions using different agent and automation frameworks such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Select the right framework and architecture based on the business problem rather than defaulting to a single technology; * Integrate AI agents with external APIs, business systems and data sources; * Turn successful one\-off client implementations into reusable patterns and components. **Client discovery \& solution design:** * Work directly with Operations, Sales, Support, Finance and other client teams to understand existing workflows and identify automation opportunities; * Determine which processes are worth automating and where AI agents can deliver measurable business value; * Translate non\-technical business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications; * Explain technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& continuous improvement:** * Document solutions and conduct handover sessions so client and internal teams can independently maintain what has been built; * Help establish reusable engineering standards and processes for AI agent and automation development; * Automate internal workflows and identify opportunities to improve how the company itself uses AI. ‍ #### **Requirements** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python or TypeScript; * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents / agentic workflows in production, not only prototypes or sandbox projects; * Hands\-on experience with several agent or automation technologies such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Confident working with APIs, integrations and webhooks; * Comfortable with production engineering topics including authentication, scopes, secrets management, logging, monitoring, cost control and API limitations; * Enough infrastructure knowledge to independently deploy and maintain the solutions you build; * Able to demonstrate 2–3 AI agents you have built and deployed with measurable business outcomes such as hours saved, reduced error rates, improved cycle times or revenue impact; * Strong client\-facing and discovery skills with the ability to communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders and turn business problems into technical solutions; * Advanced English level; * Pragmatic engineering mindset: able to choose a simple, reliable solution over unnecessary technical complexity. ### **Bonus points for** * Experience with AI evals, observability or agent monitoring; * Experience with RAG and vector databases; * Frontend development experience sufficient to build usable interfaces around AI solutions; * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration; * Security, data protection or compliance experience; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; * A permanent, fully remote role with a basic salary and the potential to participate in the share option scheme; * A seat at the table on how we evolve our methodology, our tooling and the way we work with clients. We want you shaping the playbook, not just following it.

You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes. **Skills \& Experience** Essential * Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data\-driven solutions. * Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement. * Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third\-party delivery partners. * Strong incident management and problem\-solving capabilities. * Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions. * Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices. * Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. * Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. * Strong organisational and leadership capabilities. **Desirable** * Experience supporting Generative AI, machine learning, large language model (LLM), or agentic AI solutions. * Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies. * Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements. * Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices. **Working Arrangements** This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability. jobs.title: Field CTO - Customer Engagement Solutions, Google Cloud
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We are the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG) Mid\-Market team—a specialized group of engineers, architects, and builders delivering tailored Google Cloud solutions for mid\-market, high\-growth, and fast\-paced enterprises. We partner with dynamic organizations to connect them with the right combination of Accenture solutions and Google Cloud products to accelerate business transformation and solve real\-world problems, quickly. We are expanding our team to meet the unique, rapid execution needs of the mid\-market segment. **The Domain** Customer experience is where brand loyalty is won or lost — and it's being completely reinvented by AI. Google's Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) is changing what's possible: intelligent agents that handle complex customer interactions autonomously, real\-time insights that transform how companies understand their customers, and commerce experiences that feel personal at scale. Our clients, high\-growth, mid\-market companies with millions of customer touchpoints, are investing aggressively in this space. They need lean, agile leaders who can design, build, and deliver these solutions end\-to\-end to rapidly drive customer value and competitive differentiation. This is one of the highest\-demand, fastest\-moving areas in our practice **The Role** You're the person the client trusts to make it happen. As a Technical Delivery Lead, you own delivery from solution shaping through go\-live. You design the delivery approach, lead the execution, and ensure the outcome actually transforms how the client engages with their customers. You're supported by a dedicated engineering team — you set the direction, they build alongside you. But you're the one accountable for what ships. This role is for someone who takes full ownership of their work. You care about the delivery quality, the client experience, and the result. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would. You'll work directly with clients \- sitting in their world, understanding their fast\-evolving resource constraints, and delivering outcomes that matter. You'll have the autonomy to shape how they experience Google Cloud, from first conversation to go\-live. **What You'll Do** * **Own the delivery.** End\-to\-end. Scope, timeline, team structure, technology, quality, outcome. You're the single point of accountability the client relies on. * **Design how it gets delivered.** Shape the delivery approach — define the plan, structure the team, set the cadence, and sequence the work. Partner with engineers on the technical architecture; you own how it gets built, managed, and shipped. * **Provide technical advisory across the engagement** — Guide our mid\-market clients and teams on our offerings, technical implementation, and the underlying Google Cloud services, with a deep understanding of each client's existing environment and architecture. * **Be the client's trusted delivery partner.** You're the face of the engagement. Lead status reviews, manage expectations, navigate trade\-offs in real time, and ensure the client always knows where things stand and what's coming next. * **Get solutions into clients' hands fast.** Pick up where the deal ends and make it real. Stand up the delivery, mobilize the team, and drive execution from day one — delivering proven capabilities in weeks, not quarters. * **Lead across borders.** Coordinate onshore delivery leadership with offshore engineering teams. Set priorities, define workstreams, remove blockers, and keep the entire delivery machine moving at pace. * **Drive quality and outcomes.** Establish delivery governance, define checkpoints, track progress against commitments, and ensure every engagement delivers measurable client value. **Technical Skills \& Domain Expertise** * **Gemini Enterprise for CX (GECX):** Core technical knowledge of Commerce Agents, CX Agent Studio, Agent Assist, and Customer Experience Insights. * **Contact Center / CCaaS:** Hands\-on delivery experience across Contact Center AI (CCAI), CCaaS legacy transformations, conversational AI application design, and IVR modernization. * **Customer Engagement Solutions (CES) Integrations:** Strong competency in API\-driven integrations, CRM/ERP back\-end connectors (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow), and omni\-channel orchestration patterns. * **Agentic CX Architecture:** Practical working familiarity with intelligent customer\-facing agents utilizing the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) **What Sets You Apart** * **Google Cloud Certifications:** Active Professional Google Cloud certifications (specifically Professional Cloud Architect or Cloud Digital Leader with CCAI Specialization). * **Advanced Agent Frameworks:** Hands\-on experience deploying agentic AI frameworks via the Gemini Agent Platform, ADK, A2A, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). * **Cross\-Functional Ecosystem Exposure:** Secondary familia al, vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. This role will focus on developing microservices, real\-time data streaming solutions, and modern web applications while leveraging technologies such as Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, React/Angular, and cloud\-native platforms. The ideal candidate has experience designing distributed systems, building high\-performance backend services, and collaborating across engineering, platform, and DevOps teams to deliver resilient, production\-ready solutions. **This role is based out of our corporate headquarters in Raleigh, NC. JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS. * Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and event\-driven services. * Deliver seamless end\-to\-end user experiences across web platforms. **Data Streaming \& Implement audit logging, monitoring, and observability frameworks. * Support large\-scale event\-processing platforms and real\-time analytics. **Cloud\-Native \& Container Platforms** * Deploy and manage applications on Kubernetes\-based environments. * Develop and maintain containerized solutions using Docker and Helm. * Support serverless architectures using Knative and cloud\-native technologies. * Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate deployments through GitOps, Jenkins, and ArgoCD. **Advanced Platforms \& Innovation** * Contribute to AI\-enabled backend solutions and intelligent analytics platforms. * Support knowledge graph and semantic data initiatives using TTL, RDF, and R2RML technologies. * Integrate machine learning workflows using Kubeflow and MLflow. * Build backend services supporting IoT and real\-time event streaming ecosystems. **Engineering Excellence** * Develop production\-quality code with strong testing and documentation standards. * Participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions. * Collaborate with platform, infrastructure, SRE, and data engineering teams. * Mentor junior developers and support engineering best practices. **Required Qualifications** * 4\-6\+ years of software engineering experience. * Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot. * Hands\-on experience building microservices\-based applications. * Experience with Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, and event\-driven architectures. * Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts and design patterns. * Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases: * + PostgreSQL * + Cassandra * + MongoDB * + Redis * + Elastic * Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitOps, and ArgoCD. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. jobs.title: Enterprise Support Manager, ES-NAMER-FSI
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use. The AWS Support team is seeking an Enterprise Support Manager that enjoys solving problems, working with customers, and who has a background from a variety of different fields. If you have experience leading teams responsible for building or managing full application stacks from the system (Linux or Windows) up through a custom application, managing part of a network from layer 3 and higher, or web\-related programming that includes the consumption of web services we’d like to talk with you! Open to traveling up to 25%. Key job responsibilities Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you: Champion and advocate for customers within Amazon Web Services (be their voice) Develop and lead a team of Technical Account Managers responsible for solving technical issues and working directly with AWS engineers to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible Participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment and operational resilience in the cloud Help customers define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments Engage with Director and C\-Level executives to translate business needs into technical and operational plans Work with AWS executive leadership to influence the product roadmap Drive proactive operational and security risk mitigation through application\-specific reviews, custom runbooks, and rapid critical incident response Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, and detailed pre\-launch planning About the team Why AWS? Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 4\+ years of technical team management experience * 5\+ years of direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C\-level) experience * Experience in technical team management * Experience in direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C\-level) * Experience working with enterprise software companies * Bachelor’s degree in Information Science / Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field • 5\+ years of managing technical teams **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience driving projects to improve support\-related processes and technical support * Experience in systems administration, network engineering, or software development engineering * Experience in technical account management, business relationship management, or consulting * Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings * Experience working with enterprise software companies * Past experience as a systems administration, network engineer, or software development engineer * Record of driving projects to improve support\-related processes and the technical support experience * Professional oral and written communication skills, presenting to an audience containing one or more executive team member(s) * Ability to manage and work shifts Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer- AI/ML, AWS Neuron
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Shape the Future of AI Accelerators at AWS Neuron We build Amazon Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Machine Learning Applications team, you will optimize the world's most demanding AI models at a scale few engineers ever get to work on. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high\-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology. You can learn more about Neuron https://awsdocs\-neuron.readthedocs\-hosted.com https://aws.amazon.com/machine\-learning/neuron/ https://github.com/aws/aws\-neuron\-sdk https://www.amazon.science/how\-silicon\-innovation\-became\-the\-secret\-sauce\-behind\-awss\-success Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities This role will help lead the efforts in building distributed inference support for Pytorch in the Neuron SDK. This role will tune these models to ensure highest performance and maximize the efficiency of them running on the customer AWS Trainium and Inferentia silicon and servers. Strong software development using Python, System level programming and ML knowledge are both critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low\-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will: * Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models including GPT, Kimi, and Qwen on custom AI accelerators. * Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle including distributed computing based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, low level optimizations, and production deployment. * Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architecture. * Design and implement high\-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models * Analyze and optimize system\-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware * Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks * Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling * Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators * Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques * Develop kernels to improve model efficiency on Amazon AI Accelerators * Transform complex tensor operations into highly optimized graph implementations * Optimize state\-of\-the\-art language, vision, and multimodal generative AI models for Neuron hardware What Makes This Role Unique: * Direct influence on AWS's AI Accelerator used by thousands of ML applications * Full\-stack optimization from high\-level frameworks to low level primitives * Collaboration with both open\-source ML communities and hardware architecture teams * Requires passion for performance tuning and system architecture A day in the life You will collaborate with a cross\-functional team of applied scientists, system engineers, and product managers to deliver state\-of\-the\-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and shaping the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You will also build high\-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross\-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup\-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important initiative. Work/Life Balance Our team puts a high value on work\-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and fulfillment. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS is seeking a Data Center Civil Engineer to join its design team in Columbus, OH, Seattle, WA or Herndon, VA. As a Data Center Civil Engineer at AWS, you will lead Civil Engineering designs for Amazon Data Centers. You will be part of a highly creative and efficient design team comprised of Architects, Engineers, and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo. As a subject matter expert, you will have a direct impact on the design of prototypical Data Center sites, provide technical design guidance and vendor oversight, solve large\-scale implementation issues, and build a strong understanding of site design and program requirements. Amazon’s Data Centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market and reliability. This role sits within Americas Design Engineering team responsible for the design and operation of critical Data Center facilities located throughout North and South America. Our Design Team is on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers; and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is changing the face of Cloud Computing. We continue to grow and are looking for motivated team members that can support our speed to market, raise the bar, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Key job responsibilities * Manage our external civil design consultants through the Data Center design and construction process. * Review designs for site layout, grading, power substations, storm water, and utilities. * Coordinate with internal and external architectural, structural, and MEP design engineers. * Develop preliminary site layout concepts using Civil 3D, incorporating grading, utilities, and circulation patterns while maintaining flexibility for design evolution * Effectively communicate design standards to internal and external project partners. * Communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction. * Develop and maintain design standards, design prototypes, and template specifications related to site design for Data Centers and supporting infrastructure. * Create, review, and release design RFPs for various projects, including DCs and special program facilities. * Manage multiple fast paced projects simultaneously. Foresee and manage internal Technical Program Manager’s (TPM’s) expectation regarding project\-specific cost and schedules variables. * Lead initiatives aimed at improving cost, quality, schedule, and consistency * Travel for site assessments, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with authorities having jurisdiction. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel * 3\+ years of commercial, warehouse, and/or industrial site\-civil design experience. 3\+ years in site development, grading, paving, storm water, and utility design. * Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production * Professional Engineer License * Experience in data center or mission critical facility design with basic multidisciplinary knowledge of mission critical systems, design process, pre\-construction requirements and the construction process * Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment * Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate the design and constructability of site design by third\-party consultants. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? What if you could build the AI\-powered systems that make that happen — and make it faster, cheaper, and more sustainable? Watch this video to learn more about our organization, SCOT: http://bit.ly/amazon\-scot Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization is responsible for the end\-to\-end systems that plan, optimize, and execute the movement of billions of packages across the world's most complex logistics network. jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: Job Overview This is a **customer\-facing role** responsible for supporting, maintaining, and troubleshooting semiconductor process equipment in a field environment. The position requires strict adherence to customer policies and site protocols, which may include health and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities * Monitor, inspect, set up, calibrate, and maintain semiconductor process equipment to minimize downtime * Troubleshoot hardware and software issues and implement effective solutions * Collect and analyze data related to software issues and coordinate with global engineering teams * Accurately document all maintenance activities and generate detailed field service reports * Install equipment control software and maintain software revision records * Support installation and commissioning of equipment at customer sites * Monitor service parts inventory to ensure adequate stock for repairs and preventive maintenance * Provide training and technical support to junior technicians * Communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders * Escalate complex or critical issues to senior engineering staff when required Qualifications \& Experience * High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent experience required * Associate or Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field preferred * 1–2 years of relevant experience (Field Service Engineer, Technician, or similar engineering role in semiconductor or related industries) * Experience with PVD or semiconductor vacuum equipment required * Experience with multi\-chamber cluster tools and robotics strongly preferred * Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics * Experience with PLCs and other industrial software applications is a plus * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills * Ability to work independently after 3–6 months of on\-the\-job training * Capable of determining root causes and following a structured problem\-resolution approach * Ability to recommend spare parts and consumables for preventive maintenance and repairs Travel \& Work Requirements * Domestic travel up to 25%; jobs.title: Data Engineer, Apple Ads
jobs.description: At Apple, we build products and services that enrich people’s lives. Apple Ads helps customers discover relevant products and content while enabling developers, publishers, and advertisers to grow their businesses. Privacy is fundamental to how we design and build our advertising platform. The Apple Ads engineering organization operates large\-scale data systems that process and transform high\-volume advertising events into reliable datasets and products used for reporting, measurement, analytics, and other critical business functions. We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building large\-scale distributed data processing systems. In this role, you will design, develop, and operate production data pipelines using technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Java/Scala, cloud storage, and modern data lake technologies. You will work on challenging problems involving large\-scale batch and streaming data processing, data correctness, privacy, reliability, scalability, and performance. You will have opportunities to own systems end\-to\-end\-from architecture and implementation through deployment, observability, and production support. **Description** As a Software Engineer on the Apple Ads data engineering team, you will help build the next generation of scalable data processing and reporting infrastructure. You will design and implement distributed data pipelines that process large volumes of advertising events across batch, near\-real\-time, and streaming execution environments. You will work on systems where correctness, data quality, performance, reliability, and privacy are critical. The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer who also has hands\-on experience with Apache Spark and large\-scale data processing. You should be comfortable reasoning about distributed systems, debugging complex data pipelines, optimizing Spark workloads, designing data models, and building production\-quality software around big\-data processing frameworks. Deep expertise in Apache Spark performance tuning and optimization. Experience with Apache Iceberg or similar modern data lake/lakehouse technologies. Experience with both batch and real\-time/streaming architectures, including Kafka and/or Flink. Experience building data platforms or processing frameworks that are reused by multiple teams or pipelines. Experience with AWS technologies, including S3 and Kubernetes/EKS or equivalent cloud platforms. Experience running distributed workloads using Kubernetes and containerized environments. Familiarity with analytical data stores and query engines such as Druid, Trino, or similar technologies. Experience designing systems that support replay, backfills, reprocessing, and late\-arriving data. Experience implementing data\-quality, reconciliation, lineage, or data\-contract frameworks. Understanding of privacy\-preserving data processing and secure handling of large\-scale datasets. Experience building systems for advertising, measurement, reporting, or analytics. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex projects and drive them from design through production. **Minimum Qualifications** 3\+ years of professional software engineering or data engineering experience building production systems. Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and distributed systems concepts. jobs.description: **Tier 2 IT Support Specialist** **Home\-Based / Hybrid – 3 Days Remote / 2 Days Onsite in Sunrise, Florida** **About Artemis IT** Artemis IT is a leading Managed Services Provider (MSP) based in Melbourne, Florida. For more than 30 years, we’ve helped organizations throughout Florida leverage technology to improve productivity, security, and business success. Our technical team supports a wide variety of customer environments and technologies, providing an opportunity to continuously learn, solve new challenges, and build a long\-term career in IT. If you’re passionate about technology, enjoy solving problems, take ownership of customer issues, and want to continue developing your skills in Microsoft cloud and modern workplace technologies, we’d love to meet you. **Position Summary** The Tier 2 IT Support Specialist serves as an escalation resource for our Tier 1 Service Desk and support team and plays a key role in delivering exceptional technical support to our managed services customers. This is a **home\-based hybrid position located in South Florida**. The specialist will typically spend **two days per week providing onsite technical support at an assigned Artemis IT customer location in Sunrise, Florida, and three days per week working remotely from home as part of our Tier 2 support and escalation team**. Some additional customer dispatching may be required during traditional remote work from home days. Candidates should live within a reasonable commuting distance of Sunrise and be comfortable traveling to the assigned customer location on scheduled onsite days. Occasional travel to other customer locations may be required based on business needs. The ideal candidate has solid troubleshooting skills across Windows desktop, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and networking, along with exposure to server, cloud, endpoint management, and infrastructure technologies. This role requires someone who can think critically, take ownership of technical issues through resolution, communicate effectively with customers, identify root causes, and recognize opportunities to reduce recurring problems. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced IT support professional who wants the flexibility of a primarily home\-based position while maintaining direct customer interaction and developing deeper expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, cybersecurity, automation, and Microsoft Modern Workplace technologies. **What You’ll Do** **Tier 2 Support \& Escalation** * Own escalated Tier 2 support issues through resolution, coordinating with senior engineers when additional escalation is required. * Provide remote Tier 2 escalation support to Artemis IT managed services customers during home\-based workdays. * Troubleshoot and resolve Windows desktop, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, server, network, and application issues. * Identify root causes and recurring technical problems and recommend improvements that increase reliability and reduce future support requests. * Provide clear and professional communication to customers throughout the troubleshooting and resolution process. * Collaborate with Tier 1 technicians and other technical team members to resolve issues and share knowledge. * Assist with more advanced technical issues and projects under the guidance of senior administrators and engineers. **Dedicated Onsite Customer Support** * Serve as the assigned onsite technical resource for an Artemis IT managed services customer in **Sunrise, Florida, approximately two days per week**. * Build strong relationships with customer users and leadership while providing responsive, professional technical support. * Proactively identify technology issues and opportunities for improvement while onsite rather than relying solely on incoming support requests. * Troubleshoot workstation, printer, conference room, network, wireless, and other technology issues. * Maintain accurate customer documentation and communicate issues requiring additional resources or follow\-up to the appropriate Artemis team members. **Microsoft 365 \& Modern Workplace** * Perform routine Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting, including user accounts, licensing, groups, permissions, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. * Support Microsoft Entra ID identities, authentication, MFA, and access\-related issues. * Assist with Microsoft Intune device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, and policy management. * Support Windows 10/11 device configuration, troubleshooting, security, and lifecycle management. * Develop increasing proficiency with Microsoft Modern Workplace technologies through hands\-on experience, training, and certification. **Systems \& Infrastructure Support** * Support Windows Server and Active Directory environments. * Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, VPN, firewall, wireless, and network connectivity issues. * Assist with server, virtualization, backup, and infra  10/11 **Windows Server** Active Directory **Microsoft Defender** Fortinet **Datto RMM** Datto BCDR **Autotask PSA** IT Glue **Hyper\-V** Veeam **PowerShell** You are **not expected to already be an expert in every platform**. We are looking for strong technical fundamentals, troubleshooting ability, customer service, ownership, and the desire to continue learning. **What Success Looks Like** Within your first year, you should be able to: * Independently resolve most Tier 2 support issues within your areas of responsibility. * Provide exceptional onsite technical support and build a strong relationship with your assigned customer in Sunrise. * Work effectively and independently from your home office while remaining connected and collaborative with the Artemis service team. * Effectively troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and common networking issues. * Recognize when an issue requires escalation and effectively collaborate with senior technical resources. * Maintain accurate, useful customer and technical documentation. * Identify recurring technical issues and recommend improvements that address the root cause. * Demonstrate increasing proficiency with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, security, and automation. * Share knowledge and help strengthen the capabilities of the overall service team. **Why Join Artemis IT?** At Artemis IT, you’ll work alongside a collaborative team that believes in sharing knowledge, solving problems together, and investing in professional growth. We are committed to helping our technical staff build **careers—not just jobs**. We provide: * **Home\-based work three days per week** * A consistent two\-day\-per\-week onsite customer assignment * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * Paid Time Off and company holidays * Paid Microsoft certification training * Career advancement opportunities * Exposure to a wide variety of technologies and industries * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft 365, and modern cloud technologies * Opportunities to work alongside experienced administrators and engineers * A supportive, team\-oriented environment where ideas and continuous improvement are encouraged **Grow Your Career** The Tier 2 IT Support Specialist is part of Artemis IT’s defined technical career path. As your skills and experience grow, advancement opportunities may include roles such as: * Modern Workplace Systems Administrator * Senior Support Specialist * Systems Engineer * Cloud Engineer As Artemis continues expanding our Microsoft Modern Workplace practice, you’ll have opportunities to develop deeper expertise in cloud identity, endpoint management, automation, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and Microsoft cloud technologies. If you are a strong IT support professional in the South Florida area who enjoys solving problems, working directly with customers, taking ownership of technical issues, and continuously developing your skills, we’d like to hear from you. **Ready to build your career with Artemis IT? Apply today.** Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $52,000\.00 \- $62,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of professional IT support experience to you have? * Have you worked in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or multi\-client IT support environment before? * What is your desired annual salary for this role? * Briefly describe your experience with Windows Server environments. * Briefly describe your experience with Windows Desktop and M365 environments. * Briefly describe your experience with Firewalls, Routing, and Network Switching. * Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this role? * Briefly describe your experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Intune. Ability to Commute: * Sunrise, FL (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Sunrise, FL: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sunrise, FL

jobs.title: ITS Leader
jobs.description: Intelligent Transport Systems Americas Region  WAS00007U Requisition \# **Joining Arup** Arup’s purpose, shared values, and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. At Arup, our decisions and actions aim to produce safe, inclusive, and resilient communities, infrastructure, and cities. Arup is an employee\-owned, global engineering and consulting firm. Our integrated, cross\-disciplinary approach brings together planners, engineers, designers, digital specialists, and advisors to meet our clients’ needs. Our West Coast Transportation team is looking for an Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Associate to provide local senior leadership for West Coast ITS projects and pursuits while working as part of the Americas ITS / Intelligent Mobility team. Seattle is the preferred location, with consideration for other West Coast Arup offices (Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego). The role will support a growing ITS business across the Americas, with a focus on West Coast clients, projects, and pursuits. **The Opportunity** The ITS / Intelligent Mobility team supports public agencies, airports, campuses, and infrastructure owners on projects that combine transportation operations, technology, systems engineering, and implementation. Example work includes: * WSDOT TSMO On\-Call and WSDOT Drone Researc * Port Hood / Hood River White Salmon Bridge Replacemen * Stanford University traffic monitoring / LPR proof of concep * CVX Studies / Concept of Operations / Engineering Service * California High Speed Rail technology suppor * TxDOT Future Connected Corrido * NYSDOT TSM * Lower Hudson Transit Link Responsibilities * Support Regional Leader to grow Americas ITS business leading the Westcoast geography. * Lead ITS / Intelligent Mobility assignments from planning and Concept of Operations through design, systems engineering, deployment support, testing, and operations consulting. * Manage task orders and work packages, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing, risk, and deliverable quality. * Provide senior technical review for ITS plans, specifications, requirements, cost estimates, Concept of Operations documents, and systems acceptance testing materials. * Support business development, client relationships, capture planning, proposals, and interviews for ITS\-led and ITS\-supported work. * Work across roadway, transport planning, civil, electrical, digital, systems, advisory, and operations teams to integrate ITS into multidisciplinary projects. Mentor junior and mid\-level staff and help build West Coast ITS delivery capacity. * At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. **Is this role right for you?** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, transportation engineering, electrical engineering, communications engineering, systems engineering, planning, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in ITS, traffic operations, transportation technology, intelligent mobility, or related infrastructure work. * Experience leading projects, task orders, or major work packages, including client coordination, scope, fee, schedule, staffing, and quality control. * Experience with public\-sector transportation clients. West Coast DOTs, transit, airport, campus, city, or smart mobility experience is preferred. * Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills for technical and non\-technical audiences. * PE preferred. AICP, PTOE, PMP, RSP, CCNA, systems engineering credentials, or comparable qualifications are also relevant. Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world. **What we offer you** At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. **Benefits at Work** \- At Arup, we have a comprehensive and valuable benefits program that works for our employees and their families while keeping costs low. These benefits provide health and welfare security for you as well as paid time off for rest and renewal. As a member of Arup, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance). Our Global Profit Share Plan (paid bi\-annually) provides an opportunity for you to share in the success of the Firm. As a valued employee of Arup, you can also choose to participate in our 401(k) plan with up to 10% company match to help you save for your future **Flexible Working** \- We believe that flexible arrangements create a more inclusive way of working that supports our diversity and the wellbeing of our people. Options for alternative schedules and the ability to work outside of the office for a portion of your workweek are available **San Diego Hiring Range** – Hiring Range \- The good faith base salary hiring range for this job if performed in San Diego is $180,000 to $200,000 per year. **This range is commensurate with experience, educational background, and skill level.** Benefits are not included in the base salary. Please note hiring ranges for candidates performing work outside of San Diego will differ. **Different People, Shared Values** Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. jobs.title: 3D Product Configurator & Commerce Integration
jobs.description: **Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration** Drive Commerce / WebGL, integrated with SAP S/4HANA, Centric PLM and PIM/MDM **About Us** Atlas Systems Inc. is a software solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas delivers solutions across GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare and ERP for customers worldwide, combining more than two decades of software experience with global reach and deep expertise across multiple industry verticals. This role sits within our enterprise retail practice, supporting a premium consumer\-products brand’s direct\-to\-consumer personalization program — where customers configure personalized products (imprinting, embroidery, laser engraving, monogramming, and color / material options) through interactive 3D experiences that must flow cleanly into an SAP S/4HANA\-based commerce and manufacturing backbone. To apply: https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/617 **Role Snapshot** **Job Title** Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration **Location** United States (remote, with periodic on\-site at the client site as required) **Work Model** Hybrid / Remote **Experience** 8\+ years **Employment Type** Full\-time **Position Summary** We are seeking a Senior Engineer to own the technical implementation, architecture and support of interactive 3D product\-configuration experiences — and, critically, their integration into the enterprise product\-data and order ecosystem. This is not a rendering\-only role. Success depends equally on a high\-fidelity 3D front end and on translating each customer configuration into a correct, orderable SKU, Bill of Materials and price within SAP S/4HANA. You will be the primary engineering owner for the configurator platform (Drive Commerce / WebGL) and its connections to the commerce platform (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), product lifecycle management (Centric PLM), the PIM / MDM layer (Precisely EnterWorks), integration middleware (webMethods), and downstream order management and fulfillment (Manhattan / WMS). In short: you make sure that what the customer configures on screen is exactly what gets priced, ordered, manufactured and shipped. **Key Responsibilities** **3D Configurator Engineering** * **Configurator ownership —** Own end\-to\-end development of interactive 3D web configurators built on the Drive Commerce plugin\-based JavaScript / WebGL framework (Three.js and / or Babylon.js). * **Performance —** Deliver responsive, performant experiences across mobile and desktop against defined performance budgets for load time, frame rate and memory. * **Stability —** Diagnose and resolve rendering, texture and canvas issues, including browser memory leaks and WebGL context loss. * **Technical leadership —** Lead architecture, code review and feature delivery for real\-time product personalization. **Configuration\-to\-Order Integration (core to this role)** * **Recipe** **SAP —** Design and maintain the mapping from a customer’s 3D “recipe” to a valid, orderable outcome in SAP S/4HANA — resolving each configuration to the correct material / SKU, Bill of Materials and price, using SAP variant configuration / configurable materials and made\-to\-order flows as applicable. * **Master\-data sync —** Keep the configurator’s variant / option matrix in sync with master data governed in Centric PLM and Precisely EnterWorks, so options, prices and availability stay accurate. * **End\-to\-end flow —** Build and maintain integrations across the commerce platform, middleware (webMethods / APIs), OMS and fulfillment (Manhattan), delivering accurate build sheets, pick lists and BOMs to manufacturing. * **Availability logic —** Implement made\-to\-order availability and lead\-time logic in the configuration experience (finished\-product availability and lead times, not raw\-material inventory). **Data, Pricing \& Accuracy** * **Data contracts —** Establish stable data contracts (JSON payloads, catalog indexes, option and price models) between the front end and back\-end systems. * **Accuracy —** Ensure price and SKU accuracy end to end, so the configured price and product match what is ordered, invoiced and manufactured. * **Color fidelity —** Implement ICC\-based color management so on\-screen color matches the manufactured product across materials, thread, print and engraving. * **Moderation —** Implement personalization safeguards — profanity and trademark / brand moderation on custom text and uploaded logos. **Asset \& Pipeline Collaboration** * **Asset workflows —** Partner with 3D design / asset teams (internal or agency) to translate high\-fidelity CAD / mesh assets into optimized web assets, communicating payload, texture and performance constraints. Deep 3D artistry and shader authoring are a plus, not the primary function of this role. * **Versioning —** Maintain versioned asset and configuration pipelines with clear release control. **Quality, Performance \& Support** * **Metrics e production support for the configurator and its integrations. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant e\-commerce storefront and / or product\-configurator development. * Hands\-on experience with web\-based 3D graphics — WebGL with Three.js and / or Babylon.js — including performance optimization and browser memory management. * Demonstrated experience integrating a storefront or configurator with enterprise back\-end systems — ERP (ideally SAP), PLM and / or PIM / MDM — covering product master data, pricing and BOM / order flows. This is the key differentiator for the role. * Strong JavaScript / TypeScript and modern front\-end framework experience (React or Next.js; Vue acceptable), REST / GraphQL API design and state management. * Experience delivering complex visual and commerce software within cross\-functional agile teams. **Preferred / Strongly Desired** * Drive Commerce Customizer / 3D Configurator Platform and Drive Recipe API, or a comparable configurator platform. * Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA / OCAPI / cartridges), or an equivalent enterprise commerce platform. * SAP integration experience — variant configuration / configurable materials, material master, pricing and BOM; integration middleware such as web Methods. * Centric PLM and / or Precisely Enter Works, or comparable PLM / PIM / MDM platforms. * Manhattan or comparable WMS / order\-fulfillment integration. * ICC color management and personalization / customization commerce experience (imprint, embroidery, engraving, monogramming). **Technical Skills** * **Front\-end \& 3D:** JavaScript / TypeScript, WebGL, Three.js / Babylon.js, React / Next.js, shaders and materials (working knowledge), responsive UX, browser performance profiling. * **Integration \& data:** REST / GraphQL APIs, JSON / XML transforms, event and middleware patterns (webMethods or similar), product\-data and SKU / variant modeling, pricing models. * **Commerce \& ERP:** SFCC (or equivalent), SAP product and order concepts (variant configuration, material master, BOM, pricing), OMS / WMS order flows. * **Tooling:** Git / GitHub, Jira, CI / CD (Azure DevOps or similar), Webpack / Vite, Postman; AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot). **Preferred Certifications** * Salesforce Certified B2C Commerce Developer. * Relevant 3D / WebGL or cloud developer certifications (e.g., AWS or Azure Associate). * Certified Scrum Master (CSM). **Success Measures (first 6–12 months)** * **Performance —** The configurator meets performance targets — Largest Contentful Paint and Core Web Vitals within target on mid\-tier mobile, and a stable target frame rate under full option load. * **Configuration\-to\-order accuracy —** A defined, high percentage of configurations resolve to the correct SAP material / SKU, BOM and price with no manual correction. * **Price accuracy —** The configured price matches the ordered and invoiced price. * **Reliability —** Low configurator error and defect rates in production, and high uptime for the configurator and its integrations. * **Fidelity \& safeguards —** On\-screen color matches manufactured output within agreed tolerance, and personalization moderation prevents disallowed content. * **Scalability —** Reusable components and clear documentation reduce time\-to\-launch for new configurable products. **Core Competencies** * Bridges front\-end 3D engineering and enterprise commerce / ERP integration. * Strong systems thinking across product data, pricing and order flows. * Performance and memory debugging in the browser. * Clear communication with creative, commerce and ERP / data teams. * Ownership of and accountability for accuracy from configuration to manufactured product. * Rapidly learns and integrates new interactive and integration technologies.
