jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description: **Chief Operating Officer (COO)** **Company:** Blazing Cards**Industry:** Trading Cards / Collectibles / Livestream Commerce**Position:** Chief Operating Officer (COO)**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \- Salary Exempt**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer **About the Company** Blazing Cards is building a next\-generation trading card and collectibles company centered around livestream commerce, entertainment, and an exceptional customer experience. Our business combines trading cards, livestream shopping, collectibles, community, and entertainment. As we scale, we are looking for a highly capable and entrepreneurial Chief Operating Officer to build and manage the operational infrastructure required to grow the company. **The Role** The COO will be responsible for turning the company's strategy into a scalable, efficient operating system. Working directly with ownership, you will oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the business and take ownership of the systems, people, processes, and financial discipline required to scale. Your goal is simple: **Make the company operate exceptionally well as it grows.** The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with a willingness to get into the details. You should be equally comfortable reviewing company KPIs, fixing an inventory process, interviewing a new employee, evaluating livestream performance, or designing a better fulfillment workflow. **Core Responsibilities1\. Company Operations \& Execution** Own the company's day\-to\-day operating performance. Responsibilities include: * Translate the CEO's strategy and company goals into actionable operating plans. * Establish weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual operating priorities. * Build processes that allow the company to scale without sacrificing customer experience or profitability. * Create clear accountability across departments. * Identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions. * Develop SOPs for critical business functions. * Establish company\-wide operating rhythms, meetings, reporting, and performance reviews. * Ensure projects are completed on time and owners are held accountable for results. * Continuously improve efficiency throughout the organization. The COO should ultimately become the person the CEO can rely on to ensure that important initiatives actually get executed. **2\. Livestream Operations** Own the operational infrastructure behind the company's livestream business. Responsibilities include: * Develop repeatable processes for planning and executing livestream shows. * Coordinate hosts, inventory, production staff, moderators, fulfillment teams, and customer service. * Establish pre\-show, live\-show, and post\-show operating procedures. * Create scheduling systems for livestream hosts and production teams. * Track livestream performance, including: * Revenue per stream * Revenue per hour * Gross profit per stream * Average order value * Conversion rate * Customer acquisition * Repeat customer behavior * Host performance * Product performance * Identify which products, formats, hosts, promotions, and show concepts produce the strongest results. * Improve livestream efficiency, entertainment quality, and profitability. * Ensure inventory sold during livestreams is accurately tracked and fulfilled. * Develop contingency procedures for technical failures, inventory issues, payment problems, and customer disputes. **3\. Inventory Management \& Trading Card Operations** Inventory control is one of the most important responsibilities of this position. The COO will oversee systems for: * Receiving * Cataloging * Storage * Allocation * Livestream inventory * E\-commerce inventory * Mystery products * Order fulfillment * Returns * Damaged products * High\-value collectibles Responsibilities include: * Maintain accurate real\-time inventory records. * Establish chain\-of\-custody procedures for high\-value cards and sealed products. * Implement regular inventory reconciliation and audits. * Establish controls designed to prevent theft, loss, misallocation, or inventory discrepancies. * Track inventory turnover and aging. * Identify slow\-moving inventory. * Develop strategies to efficiently monetize aging inventory. * Establish inventory purchasing and replenishment models. * Work with leadership to determine appropriate inventory levels. * Track inventory profitability by product/category. * Ensure the company has sufficient inventory for upcoming livestreams and promotions. **4\. Fulfillment \& Logistics** Build a fulfillment operation capable of supporting significant transaction volume. Responsibilities include: * Monitor fulfillment KPIs. * Plan staffing and warehouse capacity as order volume increases. Key metrics may include: * Orders shipped per day * Average fulfillment time * Cost per shipment * Order accuracy * Lost/damaged shipment rate * Return rate * Customer complaints related to fulfillment **5\. Financial \& Unit\-Economic Discipline** Work closely with the CEO and fin g with technology and data. **10\. KPI Reporting \& Data** Build a data\-driven operating culture. The COO should establish a company operating dashboard that gives leadership visibility into the health of the business. Metrics may include: **Revenue** * Daily/weekly/monthly revenue * Revenue per livestream * Revenue per livestream hour * Revenue by host * Revenue by product **Profitability** * Gross margin * Contribution margin * Profit per livestream * Profit per product * Shipping and fulfillment costs **Inventory** * Inventory value * Inventory turnover * Inventory aging * Inventory shrinkage * Days of inventory **Customers** * Average order value * Repeat purchase rate * Refund rate * Chargeback rate * Customer service volume **Operations** * Orders processed * Fulfillment time * Fulfillment accuracy * Labor cost per order * Customer\-service response time The COO will present operating results to the CEO and leadership team regularly and identify areas requiring action. **11\. Scaling the Business** Prepare the company's operations for substantial growth. The COO should continually ask: **"What breaks if the company becomes 5x larger?"** And then build the infrastructure before it breaks. Responsibilities include: * Capacity planning * Warehouse planning * Staffing forecasts * Technology requirements * Inventory requirements * Process automation * Management structure * Vendor capacity * Fulfillment capacity * Customer\-service capacity **What We're Looking For** The ideal candidate has: * Significant experience operating or scaling a high\-growth business. * Strong leadership and people\-management experience. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving ability. * Experience building operational systems and processes. * Strong financial and business judgment. * Experience managing budgets and understanding unit economics. * Experience with inventory\-heavy, e\-commerce, retail, marketplace, livestream\-commerce, collectibles, logistics, or similar businesses. * Excellent organizational and project\-management skills. * Comfort operating in a fast\-moving startup environment. * High personal accountability. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * The ability to make decisions with incomplete information and adjust quickly as new information becomes available. Experience in trading cards or collectibles is highly desirable but not necessarily required if the candidate has exceptional operating experience in a relevant industry. **What Success Looks Like** Within the first 12 months, a successful COO should have: * Built a reliable company\-wide operating system. * Established clear KPIs and executive dashboards. * Significantly improved inventory accuracy. * Created scalable livestream operating procedures. * Improved fulfillment speed and accuracy. * Established strong financial and purchasing controls. * Reduced operational mistakes and customer complaints. * Built and developed a high\-performing operations team. * Created processes capable of supporting significantly higher sales volume. * Reduced the amount of day\-to\-day operational intervention required from the CEO. Most importantly, the CEO should be able to focus increasingly on **vision, strategy, partnerships, capital allocation, product, and growth** while trusting the COO to run the company's operating engine. **Compensation** Competitive compensation consisting of a combination of: * Base salary * Performance\-based bonus Compensation will be structured based on experience, demonstrated operating ability, and the stage of the company. **Why Join Us?** This is an opportunity to play a leadership role in a company at the intersection of collectibles, entertainment, e\-commerce, and livestream shopping. You will work directly with the CEO and have the opportunity to create the operating infrastructure behind a rapidly scaling trading\-card brand. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Technology at Bridgewater** The Technology team at Bridgewater engineers systems to understand the world. These systems synthesize and industrialize our global understanding into a hive mind of macroeconomic knowledge which enables us to educate and collaborate with the world’s most influential central banks and policy makers and carefully and strategically manage the world’s most important capital. Our technologists are engineering highly available, high performing, and highly secure cloud platforms and infrastructure which support and scale our investing operations. **About the Team** The goal of the Portfolio and Trading teams is to translate our understanding of how the global economy works into strategy specific portfolios and execute those investment decisions with maximum precision, efficiency, and reliability. Working alongside the Portfolio team is a uniquely talented technology group that builds and manages the platforms that allow our portfolio strategists, investors, and operations teams to create and test new portfolio strategies and logic, construct portfolios, and manifest our desired portfolios to securities we can trade in the markets. Working alongside our Trading team are technologists who design, build, and maintain the systems that power execution, data flow, and real\-time decision\-making across global markets. They work closely with investors and traders to optimize performance, automate processes, and ensure the firm’s strategies are implemented with speed, accuracy, and resilience. **About the Role** We are hiring a "Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure" into this team, sitting at the intersection of software engineering, testing strategy, and platform architecture, with a strong emphasis on agentic development loops and minimizing latency and downtime in production. You will own the platforms and pipelines that turn our portfolio logic into executed trades, treating infrastructure as a first\-class software problem. You will be equally at home hardening production systems and building the testing environments that let engineers and autonomous agents ship changes quickly and safely, taking end\-to\-end ownership rather than working within a narrow, traditional IT role. Success means faster, more confident delivery for our Portfolio Implementation teams, with production latency and downtime driven toward zero. **You Will Drive the Following Responsibilities** * Own critical infrastructure and application services end\-to\-end, from design through deployment and long\-term operation. * Build and govern the production pipelines that construct, validate, and execute portfolios, engineered for reliability and low latency. * Design the environments and frameworks that let engineers and autonomous agents validate changes rapidly and safely. * Accelerate agentic development loops through automation, tooling, and self\-service platforms. * Instrument systems for observability and continuously drive down latency, failure rates, and mean time to recovery. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of strong computer science fundamentals in technically rigorous environments with a high engineering bar * A track record of applying software engineering rigor to infrastructure, treating cloud\-native development and CI/CD platforms as first\-class software * Ability to own both production pipelines and testing assets that cater to a large, diverse user base ranging from portfolio operators, investment engineers, and other software engineers. * Full\-stack application ownership, from design through long\-term operation (this is not an infrastructure only role) * Experience building highly available, performant, secure systems at scale (ability to deal with complex security architecture is mandatory) * Exposure to, or enthusiasm for, agentic systems and autonomous delivery; excellent communication and a fit for our transparent, meritocratic culture **Location Requirements** The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is two days per week at our Westport, CT campus. **Compensation Band** The compensation range for this role is $350K \- $500K inclusive of base salary, discretionary bonus, and potential long\-term incentive. The expected base salary for this role is between 50\-75% of the range. **Bridgewater Employee Benefits** One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits including: * Health insurance with 100% premium covered and access to additional concierge medical services * 401(k) plan with generous employer match * Paid time off, including fully paid parental leave and a competitive PTO package * Workplace flexibility and access to back up childcare * Financial assistance for family building support, including adoption and egg freezing * Workplace wellness, including on\-site gyms, free meals and healthy snacks, and meditation rooms * An engaged and active community that includes many company events, affinity networks, and extracurricular interest groups Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. **About Bridgewater** Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors. Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles. Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment for excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture. **Our Culture** Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision\-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self\-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300\+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re\-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else. **Why Choose Bridgewater?** It takes all types to make Bridgewater great. We seek a diverse group of innovative thinkers and push them to engage in rigorous and thoughtful inquiry. We develop people through an honest examination of their abilities and performance, enabling personal growth and professional development. We strive to provide you with opportunities that will challenge you and unlock your potential. One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits. Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Bridgewater has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment. **Bridgewater Associates, LP is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

packages, and documentation. * Strong programming and development skills in SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark. * Strong experience with Delta Lake and Databricks data\-engineering capabilities. * Experience jobs.description: **Career Area:** Marketing, Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Launch your data science or technical analyst career by building AI and analytics solutions that help Caterpillar customers manage fleets, predict equipment failures, and optimize operations around the world. You'll work with machine learning, Generative AI, IoT data, and advanced analytics while partnering with experienced engineers and data scientists. jobs.description: **Who is NTE, NTE 35W, and LBJ?** ================================= The **North Tarrant Express (NTE)** was the first design\-build\-finance\-operate\-maintain managed lanes project in Texas and consisted of the complete reconstruction of 13\.3 miles of the existing I\-820/SH\-183 corridor between Dallas and Fort Worth. Since opening in October 2014, nine months ahead of the contracted completion date, the general highway lanes are experiencing a 70% decrease in congestion time and a 15% increase in average speed. This Cintra\-led project has doubled capacity and significantly improved mobility along this heavily congested corridor that traverses the heart of six cities through Northeast Tarrant County. The **North Tarrant Express 35W (NTE 35W)** project spans 16\.8 miles from I\-30 in downtown Fort Worth to Eagle Parkway at the north end of Alliance Airport. The project is operated and maintained by the Cintra\-led consortium in North Texas. This project has improved mobility by adding additional road capacity through a combination of general highway lanes and continuous frontage roads, along with tolled express lanes that use variable pricing to keep traffic moving. The **LBJ Express (LBJ)** is currently the largest P3 operation in Texas and one of the largest ever undertaken in the U.S. It is a regionally\-significant transportation improvement project in North Texas that is relieving severe congestion in the dense urban area of north Dallas. In 2009, the Cintra\-led consortium was selected to complete the design, construction, finance, operation, and maintenance of the project along I\-635 and I\-35E. Since opening in September 2015, the general highway lanes are realizing a 60% decrease in congestion time and a 10% increase in average speed. **What makes us different?** Our people come first. We want every single employee to develop both professionally and personally. With a strong focus on growth potential, we look to our internal employees as potential candidates for both national and international opportunities. We aim to achieve greatness by promoting from within every chance we get. We work hard and play hard and strive every day for success and achievement. With a diverse group of professionals working in a fast\-paced environment, we achieve milestones constantly. And if that weren’t enough, we also offer our employees highly competitive insurance benefits, Paid Time Off, and a matching 401(k) program. **Job Description:** ==================== The Senior Network and Cyber Engineer is responsible for the design, security, performance, and continuous improvement of the LBJ Infrastructure Group’s network, cybersecurity, and field systems environments. This role combines advanced network engineering, cybersecurity governance, and system architecture responsibilities to support mission\-critical Network Communication Systems (NCS), Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), and Data Center Operations. The position ensures high availability, scalability, and security of hybrid IT/OT environments, while driving modernization initiatives, audit compliance, and technology lifecycle management across the DFW Cintra companies’ corridors. Key Responsibilities: Network Architecture \& Engineering * Design, implement, and maintain scalable and secure network architectures across data center, field, and hybrid environments. * Lead network modernization efforts including NCS refresh, segmentation, and resiliency improvements. * Ensure integration across field systems, tolling platforms, back\-office systems, and cloud services. Cybersecurity Governance \& Compliance * Lead and support cybersecurity audits, regulatory compliance, and internal control frameworks. * Develop and enforce cybersecurity standards, policies, and best practices. * Provide audit evidence, system logs, and remediation tracking for internal and external audits. Vulnerability \& Threat Management * Oversee vulnerability scanning, risk prioritization, and remediation coordination. * Manage threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring processes. * Drive continuous improvement of the vulnerability management lifecycle. Network Operations \& Monitoring * Monitor network performance, availability, and security alerts across all environments. * Troubleshoot complex issues involving routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and field connectivity. * Ensure SLA and KPI adherence for system uptime and performance. Fortinet \& Security Infrastructure Management * Administer Fortinet ecosystem (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer). * Perform security event analysis, log correlation, and incident investigation. * Maintain secure network segmentation and firewall policies aligned with cybersecurity strategy. Field Systems \& ITS Infrastructure Support * Maintain connectivity and operational performance of all field systems (gantries, roadside equipment, fiber infrastructure). * Support lifecycle management including patching, upgrades, and hardware refresh. * Collaborate with vendors and integrators to ensure system reliability and performance. Infrastructure Documentation \& CMDB Management * Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and asset inventory using NetBox and monitoring tools. * Ensure documentation supports audit readiness, operational continuity, and knowledge transfer. System Operations \& Reliability * Oversee operations and maintenance of IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, and communications systems. * Support testing, upgrades, system rollouts, and performance optimization activities. * Perform capacity planning and proactively address system constraints. Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery * Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans for critical systems. * Participate in incident response drills and ensure operational resilience. Continuous Improvement \& Innovation * Identify opportunities for process automation, system optimization, and cost efficiencies. * Support initiatives such as cloud adoption, observability enhancements, and advanced monitoring solutions. * Drive reduction of operational risk and external vendor dependency. Skills \& Qualifications: * Advanced network engineering knowledge (routing, switching, VPNs, BGP/OSPF). * Strong cybersecurity expertise including vulnerability and incident management. * Experience with Fortinet technologies and network monitoring tools. * Knowledge of OT/ITS environments and field systems. * Strong documentation and communication skills. Education \& Experience: * Bachelor’s degree in IT, Network Engineering, or Cybersecurity. * 5–8\+ years of relevant experience in network and cybersecurity roles. Certifications Preferred: Fortinet NSE, CCNP/CCIE, CISSP, Security\+, or equivalent. Working Conditions: * Combination of office, field, and data center work. * Participation in on\-call rotation. * Occasional after\-hours maintenance work. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include the ability to adjust focus, as necessary to use a computer. * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. * Regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. * Some travel required; may include air travel. * The employee is frequently required to stand, walk and sit.

jobs.description: **Job Summary:** Perform mechanical/dimensional inspections of injection molded parts. Performing Inspections for visual molding defects, and dimensional features while following customer supplied and industry quality specifications. jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About Convey** Convey builds AI teammates that run critical operations, whether it's ingesting orders, trafficking complex ad campaigns, or preparing customer reports. We believe a company's best people shouldn't be bottlenecked by manual execution. By delegating the daily grind to reliable digital teammates, operators are freed to focus on strategy, relationships, and the complex work that actually moves the business forward. We are building the era of the 100x operator. Our team is small and fast\-paced, which means every person here is load\-bearing. If you want to fundamentally change how businesses operate, come join us. **About the role** Convey is hiring a Design Engineer to own problems from statement to outcome: defining, designing, building, testing, and shipping the experiences through which non\-technical operators train, manage, and trust AI teammates. You will work across design and implementation, prototyping directly in code and iterating closely with engineering and customers. **Responsibilities** * **Own core agent interaction patterns**: Design the primary in\-app interface where operators train and manage their digital teammates. * **Shape channel behavior**: Agents do not just live in a web app. You will figure out how they interact, communicate, and escalate across the tools people already use, including Slack, email, and live video calls. * **Influence the broader brand**: Your design vision will extend beyond the core product to shape our marketing site and overall visual identity. * **Understand the agent architecture**: You will collaborate with engineering to reason about what tools the agent needs and how its technical constraints shape the user experience. * **Prototype and iterate rapidly:** You love hacking together concepts, building quick prototypes, and iterating closely with engineering. * **Build and ship, not just design:** Take core workflows from concept through production\-quality implementation, partnering with engineering to iterate rapidly based on customer feedback. * **Define teammate personalization:** Explore how teammates can feel personal enough to build affinity while remaining professional enough for enterprise customers. * **Turn customer proximity into product direction:** Bring structure and strategic depth to Convey’s existing customer feedback loops across daily customer channels and hands\-on product use. **Exceptional Candidates Have:** * **Deep design ownership**: 2\+ years of product design experience, with at least 2 years acting as the primary or sole designer on a complex product. * **Agentic product experience**: Prior experience designing for AI agents or conversational interfaces. You excel at distilling high complexity \+ capability into something incredibly simple for the user. * **Technical fluency**: You have a conceptual understanding of how LLMs, agent harnesses, and tool\-calling work \- enough to collaborate with engineers on system constraints and agent capabilities. * **Zero\-to\-one systems thinking**: You are comfortable creating entirely new interaction patterns from scratch rather than just maintaining/leveraging an existing UI component library. * **Builder's mentality:** You are comfortable using AI\-native tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Figma) to quickly put together and iterate on concepts. * **Design\-engineering range:** You can move fluidly between product strategy, visual and interaction design, and front\-end implementation. * **Outcome ownership:** You have taken ambiguous problems from an initial brief to a shipped customer outcome with minimal direction. * **Enterprise AI judgment:** You can balance clarity and delight with permissions, approval workflows, auditability, and other trust requirements. * **Strong product instincts:** You advocate for both user needs and business goals. **Additional Information** * Culture is high\-ownership, high\-intensity, and customer\-focused. * Remote employees travel to SF every 3 weeks for a few days (travel covered).

jobs.title: Founding GTM
jobs.description: **About Convey** ---------------- Convey is building digital teammates for the world's leading enterprises. Today, most companies still rely on highly capable operators manually moving information between systems, managing workflows, and holding critical business processes together. While AI has dramatically increased leverage for engineers, operators have largely been left behind. Convey changes that. Our platform enables non\-technical teams to build, deploy, and manage AI\-powered digital teammates that can execute work autonomously across applications, systems, and workflows. These teammates learn by observing operators, execute work autonomously, and help organizations scale without adding headcount. Since October, Convey teammates have completed over 1\.2M hours of real work inside companies including NBCUniversal, Pinterest, Samsara, Univision, ChargePoint, and others. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Pear VC, and SV Angel, we're entering our next phase of growth and building the foundational GTM team that will define how Convey scales. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're looking for a Founding GTM Account Executive to help build one of the defining AI companies of the next decade. This is not a traditional AE role. You'll join a small, high\-performing team at a moment when product\-market fit has been established and demand is accelerating. You'll inherit qualified opportunities, work directly alongside leadership, and play a significant role in shaping how Convey scales from its earliest GTM motion into a world\-class sales organization. You'll be selling a category\-defining product to senior executives tasked with driving operational transformation across their organizations. Success requires curiosity, creativity, executive presence, and the ability to help customers envision entirely new ways of working. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close * Build and manage relationships with executive stakeholders including COOs, CROs, and operational leaders * Run highly consultative discovery processes focused on business transformation and operational efficiency * Develop new opportunities through outbound efforts, referrals, and strategic account engagement * Partner closely with founders, product, engineering, and customer success teams to shape customer outcomes * Create compelling demonstrations and business cases tailored to each customer's workflows and priorities * Identify and prioritize high\-value use cases across multiple functions and departments * Help refine messaging, sales processes, and GTM strategy as we scale * Serve as a trusted advisor to customers navigating AI adoption and operational transformation **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Consistent top performer with a track record of exceeding quota and winning new business * Experience selling complex software solutions into mid\-market and enterprise customers * Executive presence and comfort engaging senior business leaders * Experience selling horizontal platforms, workflow automation, AI\-native products, or operational transformation solutions * Ability to generate pipeline and create opportunities, not simply work inbound demand * Comfortable operating in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments with evolving processes * Strong business acumen and consultative selling skills * Demonstrated curiosity around AI, automation, and emerging technologies **Ideal Background** -------------------- * Experience scaling with a Series A, Series B, or early Series C company during a period of rapid growth * History of selling for challenger brands where success depended on product, execution, and creativity rather than company reputation * Experience navigating multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles * Background selling platforms that can be applied across multiple teams, functions, or use cases * Evidence of high agency, competitiveness, and a builder mentality both inside and outside of work **Why Join Convey** ------------------- * Join as one of the earliest GTM hires at a company defining a new category * Work directly alongside founders and leadership * Sell a product delivering measurable ROI and operational leverage * Meaningful ownership and influence over how the GTM organization is built * Opportunity to grow alongside a rapidly scaling business * Backed by world\-class investors and already serving some of the world's most recognizable brands If you're excited by category creation, operational transformation, and helping define the future of work, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Product Data
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Engineer – Product Data** Job Summary ECS designs and builds engineered\-to\-order air pollution control and odor control systems \- FRP scrubbers, carbon adsorbers, fans, and ductwork \- for municipal and industrial clients. No two jobs are identical. This role turns engineering drawings and 3D models into the manufacturing bill of material that the shop actually builds from. You read the drawing, understand how the equipment goes together, decide what is purchased versus fabricated versus assembled, and structure the BOM so purchasing buys the right parts and the shop builds in the right sequence. You sit between Engineering and Operations — in SolidWorks PDM, on the shop floor, and in front of fabricators and purchasing every day. **Two things this job is not: it is not a business intelligence or reporting position — there is no SQL, Power BI, or dashboard work; and it is not a process, tooling, or automation engineering position. The product data is the product here.** What You Will Do · Read and interpret engineering drawings, weldment and assembly models, and specifications to determine how each piece of equipment is built. · Build the manufacturing BOM and product structure for each job — breaking the design into purchased, fabricated, and assembled content that matches how the shop actually works. · Work directly with Design Engineering to resolve drawing gaps, missing part data, and structures that cannot be built as drawn — before they reach the floor. · Maintain part data and metadata in SolidWorks PDM: part numbers, descriptions, materials, and revision states. · Process Engineering Change Orders and implement BOM revisions on schedule, using PDM where\-used to identify every affected assembly and open job. · Standardize product structures across similar equipment to drive reuse, shorten engineering cycles, and reduce shop variation. · Enforce ECS part numbering, naming, and revision conventions across all systems. · Own BOM accuracy: audit released BOMs on a set cadence, drive root cause on recurring errors, and close the loop with the engineer or process that caused them. · Serve as the single point of contact for BOM and product structure questions across Engineering, Purchasing, Production, and Supply Chain. · Support lean and continuous improvement work through BOM, routing, and kitting improvements. Required Qualifications · Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, engineering technology — or equivalent hands\-on experience in a fabrication or custom manufacturing environment. · 2–5 years in manufacturing engineering, product engineering, production engineering, or a BOM / product structure role. Build\-to\-order or custom equipment experience preferred. · Demonstrated ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, weldments, assemblies, and specifications without hand\-holding. · Hands\-on SolidWorks experience. Working knowledge of a PDM or PLM system — check\-in/check\-out, data cards and metadata, revision states, and where\-used queries. SolidWorks PDM preferred; we will train the right engineer on our vault. · Direct experience creating, structuring, or restructuring manufacturing BOMs — not only maintaining item master records handed to you. · Strong Excel skills. Smartsheet experience is a plus; ECS uses Smartsheet as the system of record for production BOM data. · Willing to spend time on the shop floor. This role is on\-site in Belton, Texas. Preferred Qualifications · Engineer\-to\-order or custom equipment manufacturing background. · FRP, thermoplastics, sheet metal, or structural weldment fabrication experience. · Familiarity with GD\&T, welding symbols, and fabrication drawing standards. · ERP item master, routing, and MRP exposure. · Formal engineering change management (ECO/ECN) process experience. What Success Looks Like · BOM accuracy at release — errors per BOM. · ECO implementation cycle time. · BOM\-driven production errors, rework, and expedite purchases. · On\-time BOM completion against engineering release dates. · Growth in standardized, reusable product structures across the product lines. Who This Role Is For The right person is an engineer who is happier resolving how a air pollutions control scrubber actually gets built than producing a report about it. You should be comfortable telling a designer their drawing will not work on the floor, and comfortable being the person everyone calls when a BOM is wrong. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of experience do you have creating or maintaining manufacturing Bills of Materials? * Can you read and interpret mechanical engineering drawings independently, including part callouts and revision blocks? * How many years have you worked hands\-on in SolidWorks PDM — checking files in and out, updating data cards and metadata, and managing revision states? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (New York)
jobs.description: **What a week looks like** -------------------------- **Monday.** Pipeline review. Fourteen live opportunities, four in late stage. A $350k deal with a global investment manager's Head of Asset Management has gone quiet since legal picked it up. You call their General Counsel directly rather than waiting on your champion. **Tuesday.** First meeting with the COO of a REIT that "already has ChatGPT Enterprise." You don't argue. You ask how long their last lease abstraction took, what it cost, and what happened when the numbers were wrong. Then you book the pre\-sales engineer to run 5D on their own documents next week. **Wednesday.** Procurement at a $2 billion fund wants 40% off. You hold the price, restructure the phasing, and get the CFO on a call. You know the ROI cold because you built the business case with them. **Thursday.** Two hours with the CTO and the pre\-sales engineer, working through what three prospects asked for that the product doesn't do yet. One of them is worth building. You say which, and why. **Friday.** Verbal on the $350k. You draft the case\-study ask before the contract is signed. Then you rebuild your outbound sequence: last week's reply rate was 6%, and you have a hypothesis for getting it to 10\. This is enterprise sales at Fifth Dimension. You own the number for North America. You sell to the people who run the firms that finance and manage the built world. Revenue depends on you. **About Fifth Dimension** ------------------------- Fifth Dimension is an AI\-native enterprise software company transforming how the world's largest real estate investment managers work. We automate complex document workflows, extract structured intelligence from unstructured data, and give professionals an AI workspace that replaces manual processes with 98% accuracy, where horizontal AI tools deliver 60 to 70%. We are a global company with offices in London, New York, and Singapore, backed by top\-tier American and European investors. Our founders, Johnny Morris and Dr. Kate Jarvis, bring a powerful combination: Johnny has more than 18 years applying data and analytics to real estate, while Kate holds a Stanford PhD and 12 years of executive experience across Silicon Valley and London. Our values are Own It, Ship It, and Don't Be Boring. We are demanding and encouraging in equal measure. We experiment, we challenge each other, and we ship daily. **What you'll do** ------------------ You own new business across North America, full cycle, from first outbound to signature. Reporting to the Head of Sales. Day to day, you will: * Source, run, and close $250k to $400k\+ ACV deals with institutional real estate owners, operators, and investment managers * Build and own a self\-generated pipeline. You don't wait for marketing leads that don't exist yet * Run consultative, multi\-stakeholder cycles with C\-level buyers and heads of function, through procurement, legal, and security review * Partner with pre\-sales to put live demos on prospects' own data in front of every buyer who matters * Build the playbook: qualification, messaging, sequencing, deal reviews. What you write down becomes how the US team sells * Carry deal intelligence into Product and Engineering, shaping what gets built next * Turn wins into reference customers, case studies, and the proof points that shorten the next cycle * Contribute to pricing, packaging, and US go\-to\-market decisions, and feed frontline customer insight into fundraising **What we're looking for** -------------------------- You've been the top rep, more than once, at companies where the product was hard to explain and the buyer was hard to reach. You close. * 5\+ years of enterprise sales, consistently over quota as a full\-cycle AE at early\- to growth\-stage B2B SaaS companies * You've sold complex, technical products (AI/ML, deeptech, fintech, or similar) and can hold a room of C\-level stakeholders without a solutions engineer as a crutch * You've navigated six\- and seven\-figure deals through procurement, legal, and multi\-stakeholder sign\-off * You run your sales process like an engineer: instrumented, tested weekly, rebuilt when the data says so * You build your own decks, prep your own calls, and don't wait for enablement teams or materials that don't exist yet * There's no playbook, the case\-study library is thin, and everyone's wearing 1000 hats. You thrive in that chaos * In the Midtown Manhattan office three days a week Bonus points: * Venture\-backed startup experience through multiple funding rounds * You've shaped GTM strategy in a scaling environment * Commercial real estate, proptech, or real\-assets domain knowledge * Deep HubSpot and sales automation expertise **What we offer** ----------------- We're building something extraordinary and we want extraordinary people. Our benefits go beyond the standard: from tailored support for life's challenges (IVF, gender\-affirming care, ADHD diagnosis, and more) to meaningful parental leave. * Compensation: $130,000 to $150,000 base \+ uncapped commission, targeting a 50/50 split ($260,000 to $300,000 OTE at target) * Equity: Meaningful, on a standard vesting schedule * 401(k): 2% company\-sponsored contributions * Healthcare: Company\-sponsored medical, dental, and life insurance * PTO: Unlimited * Wellbeing: $100 monthly budget * Tailored support: Contributions to gender\-affirming care, private specialist and scans, ADHD/autism diagnosis, IVF, and therapy * Parental leave: 14 weeks full pay (primary caregiver), six weeks full pay (secondary caregiver) * Training: $1,000 annual budget **Why this role** ----------------- Most AE roles hand you a territory and a playbook. This one asks you to write the playbook. You will be one of the first enterprise sellers in NYC, closing $250,000 to $400,000 ACV deals with marquee institutional customers and working directly with the founders on the biggest ones. The reps hired after you will sell the way you decided they should. The product does the hard part when demoed well. 98% accuracy on lease abstraction, where ChatGPT delivers 65%, silences a room. Your job is to get into that room, and out of it with a signature. Series A closed at $26 million. The team is 30 people. No bureaucracy. Ship daily. NYC hybrid office. If you embody Own It, Ship It, and Don't Be Boring, we want to hear from you.

You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership and will have direct ownership of measurable growth outcomes. jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. This position is a salary grade 7 and ranges from $86,600\-$144,900\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation. You’ll move between architecture discussions, deep debugging sessions, in\-vehicle investigation, and supplier collaboration to ship software that has to work reliably in the real world, not just in a simulator. **What** **You’ll** **Work On** In this role, you will work on software that lives in one of the most interesting parts of the vehicle stack: where embedded systems, vehicle networking, diagnostics, cloud\-connected services, and cellular/telephony behavior all collide. You won’t just be implementing isolated features. You’ll be tracing problems across system boundaries, debugging issues that reproduce only in real vehicles, balancing reliability and performance in safety\-critical code, and figuring out how hardware, firmware, network behavior, cloud services, and supplier implementations interact when things get weird. test strategy, and issue resolution. * Lead software design for the system team and drive software anomaly investigation , root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification. * Perform complex design analysis and make sound engineering tradeoff decisions across functionality, quality, maintainability, scalability, performance, and safety. * Develop embedded C\+\+ software on a telematics unit, including safety\-critical components and connected\-vehicle capabilities. * Debug software and system behavior in vehicle , in lab , and across integration environments. * Work directly with software engineering best practices across the development community. * Act as a subject matter expert for at least one platform area, subsystem, or application component . * Contribute to architecture and design reviews and support system\-level technical direction for the team. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, another concentration plus 8 years of full\-time relevant experience. * Strong C\+\+ software development experience in embedded or systems\-level environments. * Experience developing, debugging, and validating software on automotive embedded systems. * Familiarity with CAN and vehicle communication fundamentals. * Familiarity with cloud\-connected system behavior and telephony or cellular communication protocols. * Experience performing design analysis and translating requirements into software architecture, interfaces, and implementation plans. * Experience investigating defects, debugging complex issues, and driving corrective action through closure. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across engineering teams, suppliers, and stakeholders. * Ability to work effectively with moderate autonomy while escalating risk and seeking support appropriately when needed. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with telematics software, connectivity services, or safety\-critical automotive domains. * Familiarity with embedded Linux environments * Familiarity with automotive diagnostics **Success Profile** **A strong candidate for this role will:** * Write efficient and scalable code. * Build software with quality, maintainability, performance, security, functional safety, efficiency, and deployability in mind. * Shift testing and quality activities as early into development as possible. * Solve moderate problems quickly and creatively, while making intentional engineering tradeoffs. * Investigate issues independently, formulate sound approaches, concepts effectively and report workstream status accurately when projects encounter risk. * Recognize when help is needed and pull in the right support to keep delivery moving. * Help onboard and support newer engineers on the team. **Example Scope of Technical Ownership** This engineer may own or become the go\-to contact for one or more of the following areas: * Telematics application software running on the control unit * Connected services behaviors and platform interactions * Vehicle network communication and diagnostics interfaces * Cellular connectivity, packet data, APN, SMS, jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Pflugerville, TX, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; Red Oak, TX, USA; Houston, TX, USA; Pryor Creek, OK, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5 years of experience as a program manager or technical program manager. * 5 years of experience in controls engineering, automation, or systems integration within industrial or mission\-critical environments. * 5 years of experience in BMS/EPMS architectures (including DDC, PLC, virtual machines, and SCADA systems) and with communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP. * Ability to travel 50% of the time to provide on\-site support across various project locations. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems to facilitate effective cross\-discipline collaboration. * Ability to trace a failure from a software dashboard back to a physical wiring or sensor issue in the field. * Ability to translate complex automation logic into clear instructions for field technicians and electrical contractors. * Ability to focus on "point\-to\-point" accuracy to ensure 100% data integrity for the facility’s monitoring systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. As the primary on\-site technical authority for automation, you will ensure that the "brains" of the facility the integration of mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems are installed and networked to perfection. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide design development oversight and ensure owner’s requirements are met, act as the definitive resource for integrators and contractors to resolve ambiguities in sequence of operations (SOO), IOLs, and network topology diagrams. * Perform periodic site walk\-throughs to verify the physical installation, ensuring correct placement for accurate readings. * Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and field conditions to prevent commissioning delays, ensuring hardware matches programmed logic. * Ensure all installations meet local electrical codes, cybersecurity hardening standards, Google standards, and project\-specific automation requirements. * Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Teams for resolution of sequence issues, controls intent and changes to the SOO during the construction process. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Fort Wayne, IN, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Papillion, NE, USA; Omaha, NE, USA; Columbus, OH, USA; New Albany, OH, USA; Kansas City, MO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5 years of experience as a program manager or technical program manager. * 5 years of experience in controls engineering, automation, or systems integration within industrial or mission\-critical environments. * 5 years of experience in BMS/EPMS architectures, including DDC, PLC, virtual machines, and SCADA systems and with communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP. * Ability to travel 50% of the time to provide on\-site support across various project locations. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems to facilitate effective cross\-discipline collaboration. * Ability to trace a failure from a software dashboard back to a physical wiring or sensor issue in the field. * Ability to translate complex automation logic into clear instructions for field technicians and electrical contractors. * Ability to focus on "point\-to\-point" accuracy to ensure 100% data integrity for the facility’s monitoring systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. As the primary on\-site technical authority for automation, you will ensure that the "brains" of the facility—the integration of mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems—are installed and networked to perfection. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide design development oversight and ensure owner’s requirements are met, act as the definitive resource for integrators and contractors to resolve ambiguities in sequence of operations (SOO), IOLs, and network topology diagrams. * Perform periodic site walk\-throughs to verify the physical installation, ensuring correct placement for accurate readings. * Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and field conditions to prevent commissioning delays, ensuring hardware matches programmed logic. * Ensure all installations meet local electrical codes, cybersecurity hardening standards, Google standards, and project\-specific automation requirements. * Collaborate with Cross Functional Teams for resolution of sequence issues, controls intent and changes to the SOO during the construction process. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 3 years of experience with graphics development, graphics performance, or graphics tools. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role. * 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * Experience architecting and deploying graphics rendering stacks, display pipelines, or developer tools for augmented reality or virtual reality platforms. * Experience with AR or VR. * Experience programming with modern graphics APIs such as Vulkan, DirectX 12, or Metal. * Experience building flexible and scalable teams and roadmaps. * Familiarity working with any of the following: Compiler development, Android development, Unix/Linux environments, distributed and parallel systems, or developing large software systems. **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. The mission of XR Graphics is to build the graphics tools and rendering pipeline for the Android XR platform. We have expertise in various components of the graphics stack, from low\-level graphics and system bringup to developer\-facing APIs. We collaborate with application developers and hardware providers to optimize graphics stack. We also develop graphics best practices for XR and other rendering environments. The Software Engineering Manager for XR Graphics, leading a team of experts that enable the end\-to\-end graphics stack for AR/VR devices. For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Benefits/Perks** * Competitive Compensation * Flexible Scheduling * Career Growth Opportunities **Job Summary** We are seeking a skilled **Software Engineer** to join our team! As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining our company’s software. You will gather information to identify the company’s needs and program clean and efficient code to meet those needs. The ideal candidate is an analytical thinker with a proven ability to produce functional code. Software Engineer – Healthcare Systems \& AI Automation Location: Office based (Preferred: Experience supporting medical practices in the U.S.) Employment Type Full\-Time About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to help modernize and streamline administrative and clinical workflows within a growing medical practice. This role will focus on building intelligent healthcare software solutions, integrating data across disparate systems, and developing AI\-driven tools that improve operational efficiency, reduce administrative burden, and enhance patient care coordination. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience with EMR/EHR systems, healthcare interoperability standards, backend software development, and applied AI/ML solutions in healthcare environments. Key Responsibilities * Design and develop software solutions that automate administrative workflows such as: + Prior authorizations + Scheduling + Medical documentation processing + Billing and claims workflows + Referral management + Patient communication systems * Build integrations between EMR/EHR platforms and third\-party systems using APIs, HL7, FHIR, and other healthcare interoperability standards. * Develop centralized data pipelines that aggregate and normalize information from multiple healthcare systems, databases, and cloud platforms. * Create AI\-powered tools and machine learning models for: + Clinical documentation assistance + Workflow automation + Predictive analytics + NLP\-based chart analysis + Insurance authorization support + Administrative decision support * Collaborate with physicians, administrators, billing teams, and operations staff to identify inefficiencies and implement scalable technical solutions. * Ensure HIPAA compliance, data security, and healthcare regulatory standards across all software systems. * Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability for healthcare operations. Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Informatics, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, preferably in healthcare technology. * Strong experience working with EMR/EHR systems such as: + eClinicalWorks + Epic + Athenahealth + NextGen + Cerner + AdvancedMD + DrChrono + or similar platforms * Experience integrating healthcare systems using: + REST APIs + HL7 + FHIR + SQL/ETL pipelines * Strong programming skills in one or more languages: + Python + JavaScript/TypeScript + Java + C\# + Go * Experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure: + AWS + Azure + Google Cloud * Experience developing or deploying AI/ML models using: + TensorFlow + PyTorch + OpenAI APIs + LangChain + NLP frameworks + LLM\-based applications * Strong understanding of database architecture and data engineering. * Familiarity with HIPAA compliance and healthcare data privacy standards. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in medical practice operations or healthcare workflow optimization. * Experience building AI agents or healthcare automation tools. * Knowledge of medical billing, coding, prior authorization workflows, or revenue cycle management. * Familiarity with OCR/document AI technologies. * Experience with healthcare analytics dashboards and reporting systems. * Prior startup or healthcare innovation experience is a plus. What Success Looks Like * Reduced administrative workload for staff and providers * Faster processing of authorizations and documentation * Improved interoperability between systems * Increased operational efficiency through automation * Deployment of AI\-driven tools that measurably improve workflows Compensation \& Benefits * Competitive salary based on experience * Flexible work environment * Opportunity to build impactful healthcare technology * Growth opportunities in AI and healthcare innovation How to Apply Please submit: * Resume/CV * Portfolio or GitHub (if available) * Brief description of healthcare or EMR integration experience * Examples of AI or automation projects you have worked on We are looking for engineers passionate about using technology and AI to improve healthcare operations and patient outcomes. **Responsibilities** * Identify and evaluate the needs of the user * Develop software to meet those needs * Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables * Fix bugs and address user concerns * Update software as needed **Qualifications** * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred * Previous experience as a Software Engineer or in a similar role is preferred * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills * Ability to collaborate well as part of a team * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Understanding of relational databases * Proficiency in multiple programming languages * Experience with one or more web frameworks

jobs.description: Software Product Security Engineer Intern **Description \-** **Job Description** This opportunity is intended for conversion to a full\-time role that will not offer work authorization sponsorship in the future (full\-time conversion pending performance evaluation post internship and available headcount). Interested candidates must be currently eligible to work in the US AND must not require work authorization sponsorship in the future. HP, Inc. will not provide any assistance or sign documentation in support of immigration sponsorship including Curricular Practical Training (CPT) or Optional Practical Training (OPT). **About Us** Innovation is in HP’s DNA. From our origins in a Palo Alto garage in 1939, to our current position as one of the world’s leading technology companies, HP has grown to become a leader in technology and corporate culture, inspiring innovators, and entrepreneurs around the globe. HP brings together a portfolio that spans printing, personal computing, software, and services to serve more than 1 billion customers in over 170 countries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that attracts exceptional talent and to supporting our employees to succeed at all levels. We dream in over 35 languages and share one mission: to engineer experiences that amaze. **The Team:** Today, what we build in Personal Systems is across three main pillars: Advancing leadership in Computing is our first pillar * The Pandemic made PC’s essential. * We create: laptops, desktops, business PCs, Gaming PCs, Chromebooks, Education\-specific PCs, Creator\-specific PCs, and Workstations… Our second pillar is Creating leadership in Peripherals * Peripherals are your monitors, docks, webcams, keyboards, and mice…. * Let’s face it, the most immersive experiences come through things we see, hear, touch. * AND People refresh THEIR peripherals 5x faster AND MORE OFTEN than their notebooks. * You may have heard we acquired HyperX, WHERE WE DEVELOP HIGH QUALITY GAMING GEAR FOR ALL TYPES OF GAMERS …and WE HAVE ALSO ACQUIRED Poly, WHICH ALLOWS US TO PROVIDE RAZOR\-SHARP 4K VIDEO FOR THE ULTIMATE MEETING EXPERIENCES AND OUR 3RD PILLAR IS Expanding Digital Services * More hybrid workforce and more time spent on digital platforms gaming, shopping, connecting \= more need for services. * We are uniquely placed to help IT with combo across HP (PC \& Print) * Can help them tackle the pain points of a remote workforce – onboarding, productivity, remote computing – we acquired Teradici. * All OF THIS IS Supported by Security and Sustainability Responsibilities * Design, develop, and test software for enterprise device\-security solutions. * Build automation tools that improve engineering and testing processes. * Analyze telemetry data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. * Support integrations with Azure, AWS, and other cloud services. * Develop proofs of concept for emerging customer security requirements. * Troubleshoot software defects and assist with root\-cause analysis. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and Agile development activities. * Collaborate with engineering, security, cloud, UX, and product teams. * Document technical designs, test results, and recommendations. Education * Currently pursuing a master’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field. * Must be enrolled full time at an accredited university. * Has no more than **24 months** of prior work experience professionally related to the intern requisition they are applying to (not including internships, teaching assistance, research work, or military experience) * Able to obtain work authorization in the United States in 2027, and not require sponsorship in the future. Required Skills * Programming experience with at least one language such as Python, C\#, Java, Go, or TypeScript. * Understanding of software development and testing principles. * Familiarity with data analysis and software automation. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging abilities. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to collaborate in an Agile engineering environment. Preferred Skills * Familiarity with Azure or AWS cloud platforms. * Knowledge of cybersecurity or enterprise device management. * Experience with APIs, cloud\-service integration, or telemetry systems. * Exposure to AI\-assisted development or analytics. * Understanding of UX/UI principles for technical products. We are looking for visionaries who are ready to make an impact on the way the world works. At HP, the future is yours to create. Thanks for taking the time to review our job, if you think it is a match to your knowledge and interests please apply today— we are eager to learn more about you.
