jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= The Senior Solutions Architect works with user groups to solve business problems with available technology including hardware, software, databases, and peripherals. The Senior Solutions Architect work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Senior Solutions Architect translates business needs into technical systems solutions. Integrates hardware, software and network interfaces to form a system. Begins to influence department’s strategy. Makes decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding technical approach for project components, and work is performed without direction. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Lead Engineer, or Senior Developer delivering enterprise\-scale digital solutions. * Proven experience designing and implementing large\-scale digital platforms and customer\-facing applications. * Strong expertise in cloud\-native architecture and Azure cloud services. * Experience with API\-first design, microservices architecture, and modern integration patterns. * Strong understanding of modern front\-end architectures, including micro\-frontend concepts and responsive application design. * Experience leading cross\-functional teams and driving architectural decisions across multiple projects. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience with Adobe Experience Platform * Experience leading digital transformation initiatives within large enterprises. * Expertise in digital experience platforms (DXP), content management systems (CMS), customer engagement platforms, or personalization solutions. * Experience with customer journey orchestration, omnichannel engagement, and digital product development. * Knowledge of modern DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, and platform engineering practices. * Experience with accessibility standards, performance optimization, and user experience best practices. * Prior experience as a project architect, technical lead, or architecture practice leader. * Strong passion for delivering exceptional customer and employee digital experiences. Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $117,600 \- $161,700 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. (for example, but not limited to, linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components, etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Well\-rounded – hands\-on mechanical ability and passion for interests and hobbies outside of work. jobs.title: iOS Team Lead - Onsite - Dallas
jobs.description: **Lab49** is an award\-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the world's leading financial institutions. Founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley engineering practices to Wall Street, we have delivered hundreds of high\-impact projects across global investment banks and buy\-side firms, spanning distributed systems, high\-performance automation, enterprise UX, cloud, and data\-driven platforms. At **Lab49,** engineers work directly with clients to design and deliver production systems. We combine technology, design, and business expertise to solve real problems where quality, performance, and clarity matter. **LAB49** is currently looking for an iOS Team Lead who will play a critical role on key projects for Lab49 clients. Working in a collaborative and innovative project team, with direct client\-facing interactions, you will have an opportunity to apply your skills and expertise to design innovative applications that solve complex problems and enhance performance and productivity at our marquis clients. In particular, you will help build and modernize large\-scale consumer banking experiences, focusing on areas such as customer onboarding, account management, and money movement. As part of a greenfield initiative, you will lead the development of new mobile capabilities designed to support expansion into new markets and evolving regulatory requirements. ### **THE ROLE** As an iOS Team Lead, you are a true project leader. You own the technical direction and delivery of client engagements while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around you. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will design systems, write code when it matters most, guide architectural decisions, and ensure the team delivers high\-quality outcomes even when you are not directly contributing code. You will work closely with client stakeholders, designers, product partners, and Lab49 leadership to ensure solutions are technically sound, aligned with business objectives, and delivered with excellence. This is an on\-site role – 5 days/ week in Richardson, TX ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Design, implement, deliver, and test innovative iOS Swift applications while understanding our products from both a technical and product perspective in the context of our client’s business. * Communicate with leadership, product owners, other technologists and users to create working software based on an understanding of business and technical priorities. * Break down complex problems into elegant technical solutions to intelligently solve problems for Lab49's clients. * Actively contribute to the adoption of strong software architecture, development best practices and new technologies. We are always improving the process of building software; we’ll need your help to do that. * Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends. * Experiment with and learn new technologies. ### **What Success Looks Like** * Your teams consistently deliver high\-quality software that meets user and client objectives. * Engineers around you become more autonomous, capable, and effective because of your leadership. * Clients trust your judgment and rely on you for technical direction and clarity. * You demonstrate strong ownership of outcomes, proactively addressing risks before they become issues. * You can step away from day\-to\-day coding when needed without compromising delivery quality or team performance. ### **What You Should Have** * 10\-12\+ years of experience designing and building complex, commercial\-grade software systems, with 4\+ years leading Agile teams * Proficiency in Swift and experience with native iOS development tools such as SwiftUI, and UIKit * Experience in consumer banking including account management and onboarding. * Familiarity with integrating RESTful APIs and third\-party libraries * Experience with agile development methodologies * Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for mobile applications * Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and best practices to create intuitive and engaging user experiences * Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience in fraud management/KYC/AML and regulatory reporting * Experience using on device biometrics for authentication * A strong portfolio of released applications on the App Store * Experience with AppConfig community standards and enterprise app distribution * College degree in Computer Science or related field of study or equivalent experience * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Copilot) to improve team velocity and code quality, and help the team adopt them responsibly ### **Why Lab49?** At Lab49, you'll work on complex, meaningful challenges alongside talented engineers, designers, and consultants. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of technologies, business domains, and client environments while continuing to grow your career. We value curiosity, judgment, and ownership. If you care about quality, enjoy helping others succeed, and want your work to have a meaningful impact, Lab49 is a place where you can thrive. **Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.** **Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Azure DevOps Lead Engineer
jobs.description: IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. The Azure DevOps Lead Engineer will own the technical direction, standards and delivery of IREN's Azure platform and DevOps practice. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you will set the architecture and governance model for our Azure estate, lead and mentor a team of DevOps engineers, and act as the escalation point for platform design and delivery decisions across the enterprise and data center business. You will partner with Cybersecurity, Compliance and Business Systems leaders to ensure the platform is secure by design, audit\-ready and cost\-efficient. IREN's IT function supports a NASDAQ\-listed, multi\-country business spanning Bitcoin mining and AI/HPC data center operations, with a Microsoft\-centric enterprise stack (Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Sentinel/Defender) and SOX and ISO 27001 compliance obligations. * 7\+ years in DevOps, platform or cloud engineering, with at least 4 years designing and operating Microsoft Azure environments at enterprise scale. * Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring engineers and owning technical delivery for a team. * Expert\-level infrastructure as code (Bicep and/or Terraform / OpenTofu) and CI/CD design in Azure DevOps and/or GitHub / GitLab Actions, including reusable module and pipeline libraries. * Deep knowledge of Entra ID, Azure networking, Azure Policy/Management Groups, Landing Zones and Azure security services (Defender for Cloud, Key Vault / OpenBAO, Sentinel). * Strong scripting and automation skills in PowerShell and Python, including Microsoft Graph and Azure REST APIs. * Proven experience operating platforms in regulated environments and producing audit evidence for SOX, ISO 27001 or equivalent frameworks. * Experience with observability (Azure Monitor, KQL), SRE practices, and security policy governance and administration. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain architecture and risk to both engineers and executives across time zones. * Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-400, AZ\-305 or AZ\-500 are highly regarded; Terraform Associate is a plus. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Reporting to the Senior Manager, IT, the Azure DevOps Lead Engineer is responsible for: * Define and own the Azure / M365 platform architecture, Landing Zone design, governance model and DevOps standards for IREN. * Lead, mentor and develop other DevOps Engineers across IREN in Azure best practices, including work planning, code review, technical coaching and performance feedback. * Establish and enforce infrastructure\-as\-code standards, module libraries, branching and release strategies, and pipeline patterns across Azure DevOps and GitHub. * Own platform reliability: define SLOs, monitoring and alerting standards, on\-call practices and incident/problem management for platform services. * Design and implement identity, network and policy controls (Entra ID, Conditional Access, Azure Policy, RBAC, private networking) in partnership with Cybersecurity and IT. * Lead security\-by\-design and compliance automation, ensuring pipelines and platform controls produce audit evidence for SOX and ISO 27001\. * Drive platform roadmap priority and technical debt reduction, evaluating new Azure services, automation and AI\-enabled operational tooling. * Serve as senior technical escalation for complex platform incidents, root\-cause analysis and post\-incident reviews. * Manage relationships with Microsoft and key vendors, including licensing, support engagements and architecture reviews. * Communicate platform status, risks and decisions clearly to IT leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders. At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long\-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well\-being, and long\-term success. Compensation * Salary range (for San Francisco, California location): USD $190,000 \- 235,000/annum, depending on experience * Short\-term and Long\-term Incentive Programs Health \& Wellness * Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage – 100% company paid for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents * Company\-paid life and disability insurance * Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available * Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High\-Deductible Health Plan * Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources Financial Well\-Being * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Financial wellness tools and resources Time Off \& Flexibility * Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays * Flexible work arrangements Growth \& Development * Opportunities for advancement and internal mobility * Training and personal development opportunities Lifestyle \& Culture * Company events and team\-building activities We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need! IE US Operations Inc., the employing entity and proud member of the IREN group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. jobs.description: IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. The Azure DevOps Lead Engineer will own the technical direction, standards and delivery of IREN's Azure platform and DevOps practice. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you will set the architecture and governance model for our Azure estate, lead and mentor a team of DevOps engineers, and act as the escalation point for platform design and delivery decisions across the enterprise and data center business. You will partner with Cybersecurity, Compliance and Business Systems leaders to ensure the platform is secure by design, audit\-ready and cost\-efficient. IREN's IT function supports a NASDAQ\-listed, multi\-country business spanning Bitcoin mining and AI/HPC data center operations, with a Microsoft\-centric enterprise stack (Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Sentinel/Defender) and SOX and ISO 27001 compliance obligations. * 7\+ years in DevOps, platform or cloud engineering, with at least 4 years designing and operating Microsoft Azure environments at enterprise scale. * Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring engineers and owning technical delivery for a team. * Expert\-level infrastructure as code (Bicep and/or Terraform / OpenTofu) and CI/CD design in Azure DevOps and/or GitHub / GitLab Actions, including reusable module and pipeline libraries. * Deep knowledge of Entra ID, Azure networking, Azure Policy/Management Groups, Landing Zones and Azure security services (Defender for Cloud, Key Vault / OpenBAO, Sentinel). * Strong scripting and automation skills in PowerShell and Python, including Microsoft Graph and Azure REST APIs. * Proven experience operating platforms in regulated environments and producing audit evidence for SOX, ISO 27001 or equivalent frameworks. * Experience with observability (Azure Monitor, KQL), SRE practices, and security policy governance and administration. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain architecture and risk to both engineers and executives across time zones. * Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-400, AZ\-305 or AZ\-500 are highly regarded; Terraform Associate is a plus. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Reporting to the Senior Manager, IT, the Azure DevOps Lead Engineer is responsible for: * Define and own the Azure / M365 platform architecture, Landing Zone design, governance model and DevOps standards for IREN. * Lead, mentor and develop other DevOps Engineers across IREN in Azure best practices, including work planning, code review, technical coaching and performance feedback. * Establish and enforce infrastructure\-as\-code standards, module libraries, branching and release strategies, and pipeline patterns across Azure DevOps and GitHub. * Own platform reliability: define SLOs, monitoring and alerting standards, on\-call practices and incident/problem management for platform services. * Design and implement identity, network and policy controls (Entra ID, Conditional Access, Azure Policy, RBAC, private networking) in partnership with Cybersecurity and IT. * Lead security\-by\-design and compliance automation, ensuring pipelines and platform controls produce audit evidence for SOX and ISO 27001\. * Drive platform roadmap priority and technical debt reduction, evaluating new Azure services, automation and AI\-enabled operational tooling. * Serve as senior technical escalation for complex platform incidents, root\-cause analysis and post\-incident reviews. * Manage relationships with Microsoft and key vendors, including licensing, support engagements and architecture reviews. * Communicate platform status, risks and decisions clearly to IT leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders. jobs.description: **BH Job ID:**5033 **SF Job Req ID:**20284 Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. **Job Title:** Design Engineer **Location:** Buffalo, NY (Onsite) **About Us** Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission\-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80\+ brands, our products are used in various end\-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. **Job Overview:** The Mechanical Engineer engages in compressor design at the Buffalo Technology Center. All Mechanical Engineers are involved with design, tendering, product development, and testing of our equipment at global facilities. Principal responsibilities include high precision gearing design, casing design, and modelling and drafting components for MSG ETO and CTO centrifugal compressors. Mechanical Engineers are expected to have a high degree of tech savvy and continuously stay up to date with the latest industry trends. Extensive analytical and engineering effort is used to assure the mechanical performance of the compressor. The focus of this position is Engineered to Order (ETO) system design. **Responsibilities:** * Complete design evaluations that include but not limited to dynamic and static simulation of rotating systems, rotor design, gearing and air end evaluation, bearing behavior and affected component life. * The Mechanical Engineer will primarily be responsible for creating and interacting with CAD/CAM models, including drafting and GD\&T. * The Mechanical Engineer will be responsible for product improvement ideations. The Mechanical Engineer will determine relevant testing plans and work collaboratively to implement them in the ETO compressor products. * Production Testing \& Field Support: Responsible for ensuring the successful mechanical test and field operation of compressors. This will involve global test stand and global field operation support as well as a high degree of root cause diagnostics skills, as well as reviewing supplier quality deviation requests and review of non\-conforming materials * Tendering Support: In this function, the Mechanical Engineer directly interacts with the Tendering and Design Engineering teams to optimize compressor design to meet customer requirements. * Customer interaction: The Mechanical Engineer will have numerous internal and external customers. Must demonstrate ability to effectively communicate to a diverse audience and varying technical levels. * Work regularly, dependably and independently * Ability to travel including internationally up to 10% **Requirements:** * BSME/ BS in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering * Undergraduate work in mechanical design, vibration, FEA, thermal modelling, dynamics or materials **Preferences:** * Computer programming skills is a plus * Self\-motivated, responsible, clear communication skills. * Experience working in a team environment * Previous work experience with 3D \& 2D CAD/CAM tools (Siemens NX/ Teamcenter is a plus) **Travel \& Work Arrangements/Requirements:** * Fully Onsite in Buffalo, NY ability to travel, including internationally, up to 10% **Pay Range:** The pay range for this role is Min \- 70000 \- Max \- 90000\. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. **What We Offer** At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well\-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond. Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

jobs.title: AMHS Equipment Technician
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Intel is a world leader in semiconductor innovation, driving the future of computing and artificial intelligence. With a mission to create world\-changing technology that enriches the lives of every person on earth, Intel operates some of the most advanced manufacturing facilities in the world. Our Oregon campuses — located at Gordon Moore Park (Ronler Acres) and Aloha — are at the heart of Intel's global manufacturing operations, representing decades of engineering excellence and innovation. Intel's Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) team is the backbone of our 24x7 manufacturing and foundry operations, ensuring the seamless automated delivery and storage of materials across our state\-of\-the\-art fabrication facilities. We are looking for a motivated and skilled AMHS Equipment Technician to join our dedicated team of technicians, engineers, and managers in Hillsboro and Aloha, Oregon. In this role, you will play a critical part in keeping Intel's manufacturing operations running at peak performance by maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our AMHS infrastructure — the "heartbeat and blood flow" of the fab. **Key Responsibilities:** * Monitor AMHS operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, proactively detecting and responding to system issues to ensure continuous manufacturing flow * Perform timely electrical and mechanical troubleshooting to diagnose and resolve issues in electromechanical equipment * Execute preventive and corrective maintenance on all AMHS equipment and sub\-assemblies, including setup and calibration * Log system problems and errors accurately in designated databases, maintaining detailed and precise records * Respond to escalations in partnership with Manufacturing Service Desks, Equipment Engineering teams, and other key stakeholders * Dismantle, adjust, repair, and reassemble equipment in accordance with layout plans, blueprints, operating manuals, and technical drawings * Provide project support for AMHS installation and modification projects as required * Collaborate with AMHS hardware engineers and product owners to escalate and resolve complex technical challenges * Serve as a buddy, trainer, and/or certifier for team members, contributing to the development of training materials * Achieve and maintain L3 and advanced equipment certification milestones through established training processes * Uphold Intel's Safety and Quality Culture standards, acting as a role model for work ethics and results * Demonstrate flexibility to rotate across shifts to support staffing and organizational needs **As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring:** * Adaptable — You embrace change and thrive in dynamic, evolving environments * Detail\-oriented — You take pride in precision and accuracy in everything you do * A team player — You foster collaboration, support your colleagues, and contribute to a positive team culture * A self\-starter — You take initiative, anticipate challenges, and proactively seek solutions * Safety\-conscious — You lead by example, prioritizing safety and quality in every task * Inclusive — You bring a positive, welcoming attitude to every working group * Resilient — You remain focused and effective under pressure and in the face of shifting priorities * A lifelong learner — You are committed to continuous growth, skill development, and professional advancement * A clear communicator — You can effectively convey technical information to diverse audiences * Accountable — You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments Are you ready to be part of the team that keeps Intel's manufacturing heartbeat strong? If you are passionate about technology, thrive in a hands\-on environment, and want to make a real impact in the world of semiconductor manufacturing, we want to hear from you! Apply today and take the next step in your career with Intel in Oregon. **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research and relevant previous job and/or internship experience. This Position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship. **Minimum Qualifications:** * To be considered for this position, candidates must meet at least one of the following education and experience combinations: * High School Diploma or GED (or higher, in a non\-semiconductor field) plus one of the following: + 4 or more years of relevant hands\-on technical experience or military technical experience + 2\.5 or more years of hands\-on equipment maintenance experience in a related field + 3 or more years of technical work experience * Associate's degree i years of relevant equipment maintenance experience * High School Diploma or GED (or higher, in a non\-semiconductor field) plus: + 4 or more years of semiconductor equipment maintenance experience at a Field Service Engineer level + OR 6 or more years of relevant hands\-on experience, including military technical experience * Associate's degree in a STEM field related to Semiconductor Manufacturing (Manufacturing Engineering Technology) or a STEM discipline relevant to operations plus: + 6 or more years of equipment maintenance experience. \- Lift 25\-pound parts 1\-2 times per shift (on average) \- Climb and perform work on ladders 1\-3 times per shift (on average) \- Work inside the clean room and spend the majority of the time (greater than 90pct less break time) on the floor working on tool sets, processing WIP, walking long distances, and/or standing/sitting for extended periods of time. **Preferred Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of experience in: * Automated Material Handling Systems and software * Electromechanical systems, including robotic drives, actuators and micro\-controllers * Read and interpret electrical schematics and mechanical drawings * Willing to work in non\-permit required confined spaces for extended periods of time. * Design of Experiments (DoE) * Working at heights, ladders and raised platforms and MEWPs (Mobile Elevated Work Platforms). * Command centers and operations management. * Electrical and/or mechanical measuring devices such as multi\-meters, calipers and micrometers. * Role model leadership , teamwork, safety, and adherence to documented guidelines in all aspects of the job. * Bachelor's degree in a STEM field related to Semiconductor Manufacturing (Manufacturing Engineering Technology) or a STEM discipline relevant to operations plus: * 2 or more years of equipment maintenance experience **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 6 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- N/A **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $60,450\.00\-99,770\.00 USD (Hourly Role) The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Work Model for this Role** This role will require an on\-site presence. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. * ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. Product, Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Clinical Supply, and external partners, providing hands\-on project management support to assigned CMC workstreams. * Monitor execution and proactively identify schedule impacts, resource constraints, cross\-functional dependencies, technical and operational risks, and potential budget impacts. * Our combined staff of more than 1,300 engineers and design professionals have expertise that spans all major engineering disciplines to serve transportation, power, water/wastewater, mining, building, and oil, gas \& chemical markets. Backed by 130 years of construction experience, our construction\-driven engineering focuses on constructability and safety in the earliest phases of projects to ensure on\-time and on\-budget project delivery. Our rapidly growing **Power district**, which includes structural, civil, piping, mechanical, process, process safety, electrical, instrument and control disciplines, is a multi\-faceted division of Kiewit with best\-in\-class technical expertise focused on the EPC delivery model for power facilities. We offer a variety of engineering services, including owner's engineering, project development, detailed engineering and design, construction management and plant services. Our engineering teams bring power projects to life across North America in the following areas: * Gas\-fired generation * Power delivery * Environmental retrofits * Renewables and new technology * Water/wastewater **Location** ------------ This position is based out of our Lenexa, KS office. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Reports project progression updates and/or issues to Lead Electrical Designers required. * Utilize applicable engineering national and local codes. * Develops 3D models utilizing drawings, sketches, and design skills. Checks and navigates in the 3D models for interferences and constructability. * Creates plan drawings and details for electrical deliverables. * Develops sketches to accompany other concept documentation. * Develop schematics and one\-line drawings from engineering sketches or markups. * Maintain master drawing set with current revisions for the electrical and controls design drawings. * File master sets/originals, superseded drawings and originals as required in a timely manner. * Complete as\-built by utilizing Request for Information (RFI) forms, Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and red\-marked drawings from construction to develop “Conformed to Construction Records” as required. * Participates in project meetings as required. * Checks design for consistency, safety, operability and maintenance requirements before submitting to checking. * Resolves checked drawings; prove and understand comments made. * Routes electrical cables to generate a cable schedule. * Model electrical components using vendor submittals and electrical designs. * Completes miscellaneous tasks to support project development. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Pursuing Associates, Vocational or Bachelor's degree in Design\& Drafting technology, Engineering Technology or Design or a related degree. * Experience utilizing 3D programs such as MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, AutoCAD MEP, or Navisworks and have knowledge of the latest computer operating systems. * Must be able to conceptualize in a 3D environment. * Must be able to communicate through emails and utilize electronic meeting requests. * Must have a working knowledge of spreadsheets, databases and PDF software. * Must be able to represent Kiewit manner to owners, contractors, vendors and any other contacts outside the Kiewit organization. \#LI\-OT1 Other Requirements: * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment. * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies. * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required. jobs.description: Overview: **About us:** Founded in 1990, LS Power is a premier development, investment, and operating company focused on the North American power and energy infrastructure sector, with leading platforms across generation, transmission and energy expansion solutions. Since inception, LS Power has developed or acquired 50,000 MW of power generation, including utility\-scale solar, wind, hydro, battery energy storage, and natural gas\-fired facilities. Through its transmission business, LS Power Grid, the company built and operates 780\+ miles of high\-voltage transmission and 7 transmission utilities and has another 375\+ miles currently in construction or development. LS Power actively invests in and scales businesses that are meeting the growing needs of the energy expansion, including electric vehicle charging, demand response, microgrids, renewable fuels and waste\-to\-energy platforms. Over the years, LS Power has raised more than $89 billion in debt and equity capital to support North American infrastructure. **Our Purpose, Mission, \& Values:** Our Purpose is to solve complex energy problems that improve the world Our Mission is to make lives better by developing a cleaner and more reliable energy ecosystem Our Values are the willingness to participate in and help strengthen our culture of integrity, Innovation, Teamwork, and Taking Ownership Our People create value and are our Most Valuable asset. We take our values of Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork and Taking Ownership seriously and ask candidates to think about how they can help us further enhance our culture with their specific skillsets, capabilities and experiences. **Benefits** We provide our team the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and continue in their career growth. We are committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits that include 100% employer paid premium healthcare, paid parental leave and more. **About the Role:** LS Power is seeking a Manager, Transmission Planning to support and lead transmission planning activities across the company's growing portfolio of transmission development and operating assets. This individual will be responsible for conducting and overseeing complex power system studies, identifying transmission system needs and development opportunities, and providing technical leadership in support of new project development, interconnection activities, and existing utility operations across the United States. This role is based in St. Louis, MO; remote work may be considered for the right candidate. The Manager will serve as a key technical resource within the Transmission Planning team, working closely with internal Development, Engineering, Regulatory, and Operations teams, as well as external utilities, consultants, and ISO/RTO stakeholders. Responsibilities: **What You Will Do*** Lead and perform complex power system modeling and simulations, including load flow, short circuit, transient stability, electromagnetic transient, and production cost studies. * Lead transmission planning studies to identify system needs, constraints, and opportunities for reliability and economic enhancements that support LS Power's transmission development initiatives. * Develop and evaluate transmission solutions and provide technical recommendations to support project development and investment decisions. * Manage, coordinate, review, and interpret interconnection and transmission studies performed by utilities, ISO/RTOs, consultants, and other external parties. * Lead technical activities associated with generation and transmission interconnection processes across applicable ISO/RTO regions. * Provide transmission planning expertise in support of project development, acquisitions, due diligence, and evaluation of transmission system opportunities across NERC regions. * Support transmission asset operations and applicable regulatory and reliability compliance activities. * Partner cross\-functionally with Development, Engineering, Regulatory, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to advance transmission projects and initiatives. * Represent LS Power's interests before ISO/RTOs and on appropriate regional and national committees, working groups, and industry task forces. * Monitor developments in FERC transmission policy, Open Access Transmission Tariffs, NERC reliability requirements, and evolving ISO/RTO transmission planning and interconnection processes. * Manage relationships and coordinate technical work with external consultants and other third\-party stakeholders. * Clearly communicate complex study results, system risks, opportunities, and recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and other team members and contribute to the development of transmission planning best practices. Qualifications: **We Want You On Our Team Because You...*** Have demonstrated experience independently performing, reviewing, and interpreting power flow, short circuit, transient stability, and other transmission planning studies. * Have strong working knowledge of transmission planning principles, NERC reliability standards, FERC transmission policy, and ISO/RTO planning and interconnection processes. * Have hands\-on experience with industry planning and modeling tools such as PSS®E, TARA, PowerWorld, GE PSLF, and/or comparable software. * Have experience working within one or more ISO/RTO regions and understand regional transmission planning and interconnection processes. * Have demonstrated ability to lead complex technical assignments and provide sound recommendations based on study results. * Have experience coordinating with utilities, consultants, ISO/RTOs, and other external stakeholders. * Possess strong analytical, problem\-solving, project management, and organizational skills. * Can effectively communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations to a variety of audiences. * Are comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities in a deadline\-driven environment. * Demonstrate the ability to provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to other engineers. **Ideally, You Have** --------------------- * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering; an advanced degree in Electrical Engineering with a power systems concentration is preferred. * 6–10 years of direct experience in transmission planning, power system studies, transmission development, or a closely related power systems discipline

jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: The 30\-second version LeadrPro is a B2B marketplace where software sellers meet verified, paid buyers. Our AI agent, LP, now lives inside our customers' Slack workspaces — surfacing matched buyers, drafting outreach, triaging demo requests, and pushing meeting prep into the channels where their teams already work. Every customer's Slack agent is only as good as the prompts behind it. Right now, a human has to sit with each account, learn their ICP, their voice, and their sales motion, and tune the agent until it earns its place in the channel. **That human is you.** You'll be embedded with real revenue teams, writing and testing the prompts that make their agents useful — then turning what works into templates so the next 100 customers get it in an hour instead of a week. This is not a research role. You will talk to customers. You will ship on day three. What you'll actually do **Onboard customer agents.** Run configuration sessions with new accounts, extract their ICP, tone, product positioning, and edge cases, and translate all of it into working system prompts and tool configurations for their Slack agent. **Write, break, and fix prompts.** Draft prompts, build small eval sets from real customer scenarios, run them, find where the agent hallucinates, over\-hedges, or sounds like a robot, and fix it. Version everything. Document why each change worked. **Own the feedback loop.** Read agent transcripts. Find the recurring failure modes across accounts. Bring the top three to the product team every Friday with a proposed fix, not just a complaint. **Turn one\-offs into product.** The job is to make yourself unnecessary. Every bespoke prompt you write should end up as a reusable template, a variable, or an onboarding question. We measure you on how much of your work stops being manual. **Be the customer's person.** When an account says "the agent isn't getting it," you're the one who responds, diagnoses, and closes the loop — usually the same day. What good looks like **Day 30** — You've onboarded 5\+ customer agents end to end without a hand on your shoulder. You've built our first shared eval set. **Day 60** — Median time\-to\-first\-value for a new Slack agent is under 24 hours, down from where we started. You've published a prompt library the rest of the team uses. **Day 90** — At least 60% of new agent configurations are handled by templates you built, not by a person. You've shipped at least one prompt change that measurably lifted a customer metric — reply rate, meetings booked, or agent messages actually acted on. Who this is for * You've built something real with an LLM API — a side project, a tool, an automation. Not a certificate. A thing that ran. * You write clearly. Prompt engineering is 80% writing, and vague writers produce vague agents. * You can read and edit JSON, understand what a tool call is, and debug why one failed. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can't be afraid of a terminal. * You're comfortable on a Zoom with a VP of Sales who is skeptical of AI and short on time. * You're allergic to leaving a problem half\-diagnosed. Who this isn't for * Anyone who wants to "explore AI strategy." We need output, not frameworks. * Anyone who needs a spec before starting. You'll get a customer, a goal, and a deadline. * Anyone who would rather not talk to customers. Half this job is listening. Bonus points Experience with Slack's API or bot framework · evals or LLM observability tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, or homegrown) · B2B SaaS or sales ops background · you've worked a quota\-carrying or SDR seat and know why sellers ignore tools Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - AI Marketplace
jobs.description: **Wanna join the adventure?** Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space\-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. You will work directly with the Director of Marketplace to take the platform from MVP to the system behind dozens of partner solutions, on a small team where you own features end\-to\-end and ship weekly. ### **About this role:** * Build the Marketplace storefront, partner portal, and admin tooling. * Design and implement the APIs and services behind them: catalog, onboarding, entitlements, and metering. * Integrate with our mission platform for authentication, workflow triggers, and solution deployment in close collaboration with engineering teams. * Build connectors for third\-party constellations and data providers. * Own quality: tests, CI/CD, monitoring. ### **Must Haves:** * 4\+ years building and shipping full\-stack products. * Experience with Sprint development. * Strong TypeScript/React on the front end and solid backend experience in Python, Go, or Node. * Cloud\-native by default (we run on GCP): containers/kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure as code. * Comfortable with API design, OAuth, and multi\-tenant authorization. * Fluent with AI\-assisted development workflows and expected to use them. * You have shipped a zero\-to\-one product, ideally a marketplace, developer platform, or SaaS portal, and you like small teams with large scope. ### **Nice to Haves:** * Billing integrations (Stripe or similar). * Geospatial or earth observation exposure. * Security\-minded engineering (tenant isolation, audit trails). * Experience in the architecture of modern systems. ### **Some of Our Awesome Benefits:** * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents * Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA * 100% employer paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays * 401(k) plan and equity options * Daily catered lunches and snacks * International exposure to our team in France * Fully paid parental leave; 14 weeks for primary caregiver and 10 weeks for secondary caregiver * Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family\-forming benefits with financial support * Off\-sites and many social events and celebrations * Relocation assistance when applicable $140,000 \- $210,000 a year State law requires us to tell you the base compensation range for this role, which is $140,000\- $210,000 per year. This is determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. jobs.description: ##### **Project description** We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to support a large\-scale Mainframe to Azure Cloud PaaS migration program. Data Management \& Governance * Ensure data quality, integrity, lineage, and governance standards. * Implement security controls following enterprise and regulatory requirements. * Establish monitoring, logging, and operational support processes. \-Support data validation, reconciliation, and testing activities during \-migration phases. Collaboration \& Delivery * Collaborate with enterprise architects, application teams, business analysts, and infrastructure teams. * Participate in solution design reviews and technical workshops. * Document technical designs, migration approaches, and deployment procedures. * Support Agile delivery methodologies and project milestones. ##### **Skills** Must have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience. 5\+ years of experience in Data Engineering. 3\+ years of hands\-on Azure Cloud experience. Experience with large\-scale data migration or modernization projects. Strong knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, and Data Lake. Strong SQL development and performance tuning skills. Experience developing ETL/ELT data pipelines. Understanding of cloud security and governance principles. Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices. Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills. Nice to have Experience in Mainframe modernization programs. Knowledge of Mainframe technologies such as: COBOL JCL VSAM DB2 IMS CICS Experience with modernization tools and migration frameworks. Familiarity with event\-driven and serverless architectures. Experience working in enterprise\-scale Azure environments. Azure certifications are highly desirable: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP\-203\) Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate ##### **Other** Languages English: C1 Advanced Seniority Senior Remote United States, United States of America Req. jobs.description: Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer **Early\-Stage Education Technology Startup** **Compensation:** Primarily Equity\-Based **Position:** Co\-Founder / Founding Technical Lead **Schedule:** Flexible **Location:** Remote / Hybrid/ Columbus, OH (preferred but will hire best candidate) About the Company We are an early\-stage education technology startup building a new platform designed to help students explore careers, understand professional pathways, and make more informed decisions about their futures. The product combines interactive digital experiences, artificial intelligence, career exploration tools, simulations, personalized recommendations, and student\-focused content into a single platform. An initial version of the platform has already been developed. We are now looking for a highly motivated **Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer** who can help take ownership of the technology, strengthen the existing product, and build the technical foundation for future growth. This is not a traditional salaried software engineering position. It is intended for someone interested in joining an early\-stage company as a technical founder and building meaningful ownership through equity. What You'll Do You will work directly with the founder to help shape both the product and technical direction of the company. Key responsibilities may include: * Review, improve, maintain, and expand the existing application and codebase. * Lead development of new platform features from concept through deployment. * Build and integrate AI\-powered features using large language models (LLMs) and third\-party APIs. * Develop scalable backend systems, APIs, databases, authentication, and application infrastructure. * Improve frontend functionality, responsiveness, performance, and user experience. * Develop interactive experiences, simulations, dashboards, and student\-facing tools. * Help establish the company's long\-term technical architecture and development standards. * Troubleshoot bugs, security issues, performance problems, and production issues. * Translate creative product concepts into functional prototypes and production\-ready features. * Help determine what should be built internally versus through external APIs, models, or infrastructure. * As the company grows, potentially help recruit and lead future engineering and product team members. Technical Skills We're Looking For You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed below. We care most about strong engineering fundamentals, versatility, creativity, and the ability to learn quickly. Experience with several of the following is preferred: **Programming \& Development** * Python * JavaScript and/or TypeScript * React or similar modern frontend frameworks * Node.js and modern web application development * Java * C\+\+ * HTML/CSS * REST APIs and third\-party API integrations * SQL and/or modern database technologies * Git and version control **AI \& LLM Development** * Experience integrating large language models into applications * OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar AI APIs * Prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs * AI agents, tool/function calling, or workflow automation * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) or vector databases * Designing AI systems with appropriate reliability, privacy, cost, and safety considerations **Platform \& Infrastructure** * Replit or similar cloud development environments * Cloud deployment and hosting * Authentication and user\-management systems * Database architecture * API development * Application security * Performance optimization * SaaS architecture Experience building educational technology, gamified applications, interactive simulations, 3D/web experiences, or AI\-powered consumer products would be particularly valuable. Creative Product \& Design This role goes beyond writing code. We are looking for someone who enjoys asking, **"How could we make this experience better?"** You should be comfortable contributing ideas around: * UI/UX * Product design * Gamification * Interactive experiences * Student engagement * AI experiences * Visual storytelling * Prototyping * Creative feature development Experience with Figma, WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, game development, 3D environments, or similar creative technologies is a plus, but not required. Who We're Looking For The ideal person is entrepreneurial and wants meaningful ownership rather than simply another engineering assignment. You may be a strong fit if you: * Want to help build a company from an early stage. * Enjoy moving quickly and solving ambiguous problems. * Can independently turn ideas into working products. * Are comfortable working with an evolving codebase. * Think about users and business outcomes in addition to engineering. * Have strong product instincts and creative problem\-solving skills. * Are excited about AI, education, career exploration, and emerging technology. * Communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical collaborators. * Want the opportunity to influence the company's technology, product, and long\-term direction. Startup experience is valuable but not required. Compensation \& Ownership This is an **early\-stage co\-founder opportunity in which equity is expected to be the primary form of compensation initially**. The specific ownership structure, responsibilities, vesting schedule, time commitment, and future compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates and documented through appropriate agreements. Candidates should understand that early\-stage startups involve significant uncertainty and risk. Equity does not guarantee future compensation or company value. As the company reaches appropriate revenue or financing milestones, the founders may evaluate transitioning the role to include cash compensation. Why Join? This is an opportunity to become a foundational member of a company rather than joining after the major product and technology decisions have already been made. The right person will have the opportunity to meaningfully influence: * Product direction * Technology architecture * AI strategy * User experience * Engineering culture * Future hiring * Company strategy Most importantly, you will be helping build technology intended to give students greater exposure to careers and opportunities before they have to make major educational and professional decisions. How to Apply Please submit a resume, LinkedIn profile, GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of products you have built. In your application, briefly tell us: * What have you built that you're most proud of? * What technologies do you consider your strongest? * What experience do you have building with LLMs or AI APIs? * Have you ever taken an application from prototype to production? * Why does joining an early\-stage company as a technical co\-founder interest you? * What level of time commitment could you realistically make? We care more about **what you can build, how you think, and your desire to create something meaningful** than a specific degree or traditional career path. Pay: $8\.00 \- $10\.00 per hour Expected hours: 37\.5 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Columbus, OH 43268

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality & Resolution
jobs.description: **Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality \& Resolution** **Role Purpose** The Senior Support Engineer is responsible for investigating and resolving complex product\-data issues that prevent hardware from being successfully onboarded into Oracle data centers. Acting as a technical point of contact for operational support, the role partners with Oracle's global manufacturing partners, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and cross\-functional engineering teams to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and drive timely resolution of critical operational incidents. The successful candidate will manage technical investigations, recommend corrective actions, and identify opportunities for systemic improvement. Responsibility for implementing product or process changes will transition to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams once investigation and recommendations are complete. This role supports a global operational environment and participates in a follow\-the\-sun support model, including scheduled weekend and after\-hours coverage as required. **Technical Support \& Investigation** * Investigate and resolve complex product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Monitor, prioritize, and respond to technical support tickets within the operational support queue. * Perform technical triage to identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution paths. * Collaborate with Oracle's global manufacturing partners to investigate and resolve product\-data quality issues while ensuring corrective actions are measurable, verified, and minimize future recurrence. * Monitor daily manufacturing data feeds to identify data\-quality issues and operational exceptions requiring investigation. * Perform detailed root cause analysis, including writing SQL queries to examine raw database records and investigate non\-standard technical issues. * Read and interpret XML and JSON data to identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or improperly formatted product information. * Utilize REST services to retrieve, validate, and submit product data where required. Use Python, where appropriate, to analyze, transform, or validate data supporting technical investigations. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to coordinate technical investigations. * Recommend corrective actions that address underlying system or process issues rather than individual incidents alone. * Initiate and coordinate recommendations for systemic improvements while transitioning implementation ownership to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams. * Where investigations require work at remote manufacturing or data centre locations, coordinate appropriate handoff to the responsible Product Engineer or operational team. Track investigations, recommendations, and follow\-up activities through completion to ensure timely resolution. * **Operational Excellence** * Prioritize technical issues based on business impact, operational urgency, and data center onboarding risk. * Effectively manage competing priorities within a fast\-paced operational support environment. * Produce clear investigation reports, root cause analyses, and technical documentation. * Develop and contribute to operational knowledge articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support best practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, and data quality based on investigation outcomes. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership. * **Required Skills and Experience** **Technical Skills** * Strong analytical, investigative, and root cause analysis skills. * Experience writing SQL queries for technical investigation and data analysis. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting. * Ability to read and interpret XML and JSON. * Experience working with REST APIs and related data sources. * Basic Python programming skills for data analysis and automation. * Understanding of data validation and product\-data quality principles. * Familiarity with server and rack\-level hardware, configuration, and topology. Understanding of Product Bills of Materials (BOMs) and parent\-child component relationships. * **Professional Skills** * Ability to coordinate technical investigations across multiple teams and geographic regions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Confidence communicating with both technical teams and senior leadership. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Ability to perform effectively under pressure while managing multiple concurrent investigations. * Experience identifying and recommending systemic improvements that reduce recurring operational issues. Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed cross\-functional teams. * **Measures of Success** Success in this role will be demonstrated through: * Reduction in product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Faster investigation and resolution of critical operational incidents. * Reduced recurrence of issues through effective root cause analysis and recommended corrective actions. * Improved product\-data quality across Oracle's manufacturing partner network. * Earlier identification and resolution of data\-quality issues before products reach Oracle data centers. * Effective collaboration and communication across Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other global teams. * High\-quality technical documentation and knowledge sharing that improves operational efficiency. Consistent delivery of technical support within a global 24x7 operational environment. * **Location** : Nashville, TN

jobs.title: Robot Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: **About Origami Robotics** Join a small team building the platform that turns physical robot experience into better behavior. You’ll own a focused infrastructure project used by robotics and ML engineers, work on real systems, and ship something that lasts beyond the internship. **About the Role** As a Robot Operator, you'll work directly with our robotic platforms to produce the training data our models depend on. You'll use guided control interfaces to move robots through defined task sequences. Each demonstration you record becomes training signal, so how cleanly you execute translates directly into model quality.You'll run repeatable workflows, hold a consistent quality bar across long sessions, and help us make the collection process more reliable over time. **In This Role, You'll** **Operate Robots \& Collect Data** * Run robotic systems through guided control interfaces * Execute defined task sequences built for model training * Perform repetitive manipulation work without drift in precision * Hold a consistent quality standard across every demonstration * Hit daily volume and data\-quality targets **Monitor Quality** * Watch for irregular system behavior and escalate it early * Review recorded sessions and catch problems before they reach the dataset * Give engineering clear, specific feedback on what you observed * Suggest workflow changes that improve throughput or reliability **Set Up \& Maintain Equipment** * Help with workstation setup and calibration * Handle basic mechanical adjustments and first\-pass troubleshooting * Keep work areas organized and safe * Confirm systems are ready before each shift starts This role involves extended standing, full use of both arms and hands, strong hand–eye coordination, and sustained attention to fine detail. We're Looking For Candidates Who * Have hands\-on experience in a lab, shop, manufacturing, or technical environment * Are comfortable working around physical systems and moving equipment * Can repeat a task hundreds of times without losing precision * Do well in structured, output\-driven settings * Own their own quality bar rather than waiting to be checked * Speak up early when something looks wrong **Nice to have** * Prior work with robotic systems or human\-in\-the\-loop interfaces * Background in assembly, machining, lab work, or skilled trades * Comfort with controllers, VR interfaces, or simulation tools Pay: $20\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: In person Pay: $20\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Entry-Level Project Engineer – Transportation
jobs.description: **We Make Everything Around Us Better** At PRIME AE, that’s not a slogan, it’s how we work. Every bridge, building, campus, park, and roadway we design exists to improve how people live, move, learn, and connect. Through architecture, engineering, planning, and consulting, we partner with clients to create thoughtful, practical solutions that leave communities stronger than we found them. If you want your work to matter, and to be surrounded by smart, collaborative people who care about doing things the right way, you’ll feel at home here. **Who We Are:** **PRIME AE Group, Inc.** (www.primeeng.com) is a nationally ranked, full\-service architecture and engineering firm driven by collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to strengthening the communities we serve. With a growing footprint of offices across the country and a diverse team of more than 550 professionals, we partner with public and private sector clients to deliver thoughtful, high\-impact solutions across transportation, education, healthcare, municipal, federal, commercial, and recreational markets. Our culture blends entrepreneurial energy with the resources of a scaled, multidisciplinary platform—giving our people the opportunity to shape meaningful projects while influencing the future direction of the firm. As PRIME AE continues to expand its capabilities, geographic reach, and leadership bench, this is an exciting time to join a team that is building momentum, investing in growth, and empowering leaders to make a lasting impact. **The Opportunity:** We are currently seeking an **Entry\-Level Project Engineer – Transportation** to join our Indianapolis or New Albany office. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent or upcoming Civil Engineering graduate who is interested in building a career in transportation engineering. You will work alongside experienced engineers and project managers while gaining hands\-on experience supporting our Roadway, Drainage, Traffic, and Bridge teams. The position provides exposure to multiple areas of transportation engineering and may also include utility and railroad coordination, environmental documentation, permitting, and field activities. You will receive guidance and mentorship while developing the technical skills needed to take on greater project responsibility over time. **What You’ll Do:** As an **Entry\-Level Project Engineer – Transportation**, you will assist with the planning and design of transportation and infrastructure projects while developing your technical engineering skills. You will support engineering calculations, design plans, technical documentation, and project coordination across roadway, drainage, traffic, and bridge projects. Working with experienced team members, you will gain exposure to different phases of project development and learn applicable design standards, software, and project\-delivery processes. **Key Responsibilities:** * Assist with the planning and design of roadway, drainage, traffic, bridge, and other transportation infrastructure projects. * Prepare engineering calculations, design plans, exhibits, technical documentation, and cost estimates under the guidance of experienced engineers. * Support roadway design activities, including roadway geometry, grading, intersections, and related improvements. * Assist with drainage, traffic, and bridge\-related engineering assignments based on project needs. * Support utility and railroad coordination, environmental documentation, permitting, and agency coordination as needed. * Learn and apply applicable transportation design standards, engineering practices, and quality\-control procedures. * Collaborate with engineers, designers, project managers, and other disciplines to support project delivery. * Participate in project meetings, site visits, field investigations, and construction\-related activities as needed. * Maintain organized project documentation and assist the team in meeting project schedules and quality expectations. * Continue developing technical knowledge and take on increasing project responsibility as experience grows. **What You’ll Bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited engineering program, completed or anticipated by the start date. * 0–2 years of experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification or plans to pursue EIT certification preferred. * Previous internship, co\-op, or academic project experience related to civil or transportation engineering is a plus but not required. * Interest in developing experience across roadway, drainage, traffic, bridge, and other transportation disciplines. * Familiarity with MicroStation, OpenRoads Designer, AutoCAD Civil 3D, or similar engineering software through coursework, internships, or professional experience is preferred. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively, learn from experienced team members, and manage multiple assignments. * Self\-motivated with a willingness to learn new technical skills and grow within the Transportation team. **Why PRIME AE:** We don’t just fill positions; we invest in people. At PRIME AE, you’ll find a supportive, flexible environment where careers are built intentionally, not accidentally. You’ll work on projects that improve everyday life, alongside colleagues who challenge and respect one another. What sets us apart: * **Career Growth**: Flexible career paths across disciplines, from technical expertise to project and people leadership. * **People\-First Culture**: We value trust, integrity, and collaboration, and we mean it. * **Meaningful Work**: Projects that strengthen communities, infrastructure, and public spaces. * **Growth with Purpose**: Strategic expansion backed by strong leadership and investment. * **National Reach, Local Feel**: Big\-firm resources with the agility and relationships of local offices. **Our Commitment:** PRIME AE Group is committed to creating an inclusive environment where differences are respected, voices are heard, and everyone has the opportunity to succeed. \#LI \- Onsite
