jobs.title: Fabric Data Analyst
jobs.description: Turn raw data into the insights that power travel loyalty for some of the world's biggest brands. **About the Role** As a Fabric Data Analyst I at ***arrivia***, you'll design and maintain the Power BI reports and dashboards that surface insights from our Microsoft Fabric data platform, built against Fabric semantic models. Your work matters because the reporting you deliver helps stakeholders across ***arrivia*** make faster, better\-informed decisions every day. You'll have real impact, translating ambiguous business questions into clear, accurate visualizations that teams across the company use to solve problems. And it's a role you'll grow in, working hands\-on with modern Microsoft Fabric technology and AI tools inside a data ecosystem that keeps evolving. **What You'll Own** * **Reporting and dashboards:** Design, build, and publish Power BI reports that consume Fabric semantic models in DirectLake and Import modes. * **Data modeling:** Translate business needs into logical data models and intuitive, clearly labeled report layouts. * **DAX and performance:** Write and optimize DAX measures that power the KPIs the business relies on. * **Stakeholder partnership:** Gather, document, and refine reporting requirements alongside business partners. * **Governance and security:** Apply row\-level and object\-level security in semantic models to meet governance standards. * **Data quality:** Validate reports against source data so accuracy is never in question. * **Self\-service enablement:** Create certified datasets and reusable templates that let teams answer their own questions. * **Peer collaboration:** Take part in peer reviews of reports, DAX logic, and model design, and share what you learn. * **Cross\-team problem solving:** Present findings and partner across teams to turn data into decisions. * **AI\-enabled ways of working:** Use AI tools to work smarter, sharpen your analysis, and speed up delivery. **What You'll Bring** We'd love to hear from you if you bring strength across several of these areas. * 1 to 3 years building Power BI reports and dashboards in a professional setting. * Hands\-on Microsoft Fabric experience, including data modeling, is required. * AI experience is required, with a track record of using AI tools in your work. * Working knowledge of DAX for measures, calculated columns, and time\-intelligence functions. * Solid data modeling fundamentals such as star schema, relationships, and cardinality. * SQL to query relational sources and validate the data behind your reports. * Power Query and M for Import\-mode transformations. * Clear communication and the ability to collaborate across teams to present data and solve problems. * A bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience. * Experience aligned with membership or loyalty programs is a huge plus. * DP\-600 Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate certification is preferred, and required within 12 months of hire. **Benefits \& Perks** * Unlimited PTO * Exclusive employee travel rates * Travel discounts through ***arrivia*** programs * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company participation **Who We Are** At ***arrivia***, we power travel loyalty and rewards programs for some of the world's leading brands. Our teams help millions of travelers book memorable experiences while delivering innovative technology and travel solutions to our partners. With a global workforce and a culture built on curiosity, ownership, authenticity, and collaboration, we're creating the future of travel. jobs.title: Fabric Data Engineer
jobs.description: Build the modern data backbone a global travel\-rewards business runs on, work hands\-on with the newest Microsoft Fabric and AI tooling, and coach the engineers coming up behind you. **About the Role** ***arrivia*** is looking for an experienced Fabric Data Engineer to take ownership of complex data pipeline architectures inside the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem. You will design and optimize enterprise\-scale data solutions, set the technical standards the team works to, and mentor junior engineers along the way. This work matters right now. You will help migrate an existing on\-premise relational database into our modern cloud environment and play an instrumental role in decommissioning legacy data\-warehouse systems. The pace is accelerating, and your pipelines are what let the business rely on accurate, up\-to\-date reports and dashboards. Your impact reaches across the company. You will partner with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to turn complex requirements into reliable, performant, well\-governed data platforms, and the standards you set will shape how the whole team builds. It is also a genuinely modern role. At ***arrivia***, we are committed to AI\-driven innovation, and you will work alongside the latest AI technologies, using LLMs, Model Context Protocol servers, and AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and raise engineering quality. You will also get flexible and hybrid work, certification support, and a clear path to grow into Senior, Lead, and Principal roles. **What You'll Own** * **Pipeline architecture:** Architect and optimize end\-to\-end pipelines with Microsoft Fabric Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, and PySpark and Spark SQL notebooks, built for scale and performance. * **Lakehouse and warehouse design:** Lead Lakehouse and Warehouse design on the medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) pattern, and set the best practices the team follows. * **Cloud modernization:** Help move on\-premise relational data into OneLake and retire legacy data\-warehouse systems, accelerating the shift to a modern cloud platform. * **Real\-time ingestion:** Build low\-latency streaming pipelines with Fabric Eventstream from sources such as Azure Event Hubs, IoT Hub, and custom applications. * **Performance and reliability:** Write highly optimized T\-SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark, and own incremental loads, refresh scheduling, and SLA monitoring so pipelines stay dependable. * **AI\-augmented engineering:** Design pipelines that support Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, including chunking, embeddings, and vector search, and use LLMs and MCP servers to speed up and improve how the team works. * **Data governance:** Champion governance through sensitivity labels, role\-based access controls, and cataloging in Microsoft Purview. * **CI/CD and engineering standards:** Drive CI/CD with Fabric deployment pipelines, Git branching strategies, and automated testing for data assets. * **Trusted reporting layers:** Maintain Power BI semantic models where needed, so enterprise reporting stays consistent and accurate. * **Mentorship:** Coach Fabric Data Engineer I team members through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing, and help lead architectural reviews and continuous improvement. **What You'll Bring** * 3 to 5 years in data engineering, ETL and ELT development, or a related analytics engineering role. * Strong SQL across T\-SQL and Spark SQL, and strong Python with PySpark. Working knowledge of Scala is a plus. * Several years working with Apache Spark and lakehouse data at scale, writing PySpark and Spark SQL notebooks against large datasets, with real performance\-tuning experience. * Solid grounding in lakehouse architecture, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and data vault methodology. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or a comparable cloud data platform such as Azure Synapse or Databricks. * Experience with real\-time and streaming data at scale, including event\-driven architectures and tools like Azure Event Hubs or Kafka. * Familiarity with vector search, embeddings, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation patterns, plus hands\-on use of LLMs and AI\-assisted development tools. * Strong CI/CD habits across Fabric deployment pipelines, Git, and automated testing. * Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers and leading technical initiatives. * Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\) is highly preferred. * A bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. This role is multi\-pronged, so you do not need every item above. Real strength across several of these areas, plus the drive to grow into the rest, goes a long way. **Benefits \& Perks** * Unlimited PTO * Exclusive employee travel rates * Travel discounts through ***arrivia*** programs * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company participation **Who We Are** At ***arrivia***, we power travel loyalty and rewards programs for some of the world's leading brands. Our teams help millions of travelers book memorable experiences while delivering innovative technology and travel solutions to our partners. With a global workforce and a culture built on curiosity, ownership, authenticity, and collaboration, we're creating the future of travel. jobs.title: Remote Backend Engineer (Python/FastAPI)
jobs.description: **About Us:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L. **Ideal Background:** This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high\-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from leading programs such as Harvard, Columbia, Princeton, Yale, University of Pennsylvania, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree. **Project Overview:** As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting\-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections across the full stack — in Python for backend and ML workflows, and JavaScript (React, Node.js) for frontend and API layers, alongside C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI\-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code across both Python and JavaScript (React, Node.js), with additional work in C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code across backend and frontend contexts to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents that can verify the quality of the code and identify error patterns across full\-stack applications. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more). * Strong expertise in building full\-stack applications using Python and JavaScript (React, Node.js), with the ability to work across backend and frontend codebases. * Experience deploying scalable, production\-grade software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week. * Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). * Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit). * Location: Candidates must be based in the United States. **Evaluation Process:*** The application process takes 15–30 minutes. * Completion of an AI video interview is required.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L. **Project Overview:** As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting\-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections primarily in **C/C\+\+**, as well as in Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), Java, Rust, and Go; evaluating and refining AI\-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability; and working with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Working on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in **C/C\+\+**, along with Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), Java, Rust, and Go. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents that can verify the quality of the code and identify error patterns. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more) * Strong expertise in building full\-stack applications and deploying scalable, production\-grade software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week * Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave) * Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit) * Location: Candidates must be based out of the US, Canada, or WEU countries (Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, ...) **Evaluation Process:*** The application process takes 15\-30 minutes. * Completion of an AI video interview is required.

and working with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Working on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in **Rust**, along with Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, and Go. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents that can verify the quality of the code and identify error patterns. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more). * Strong expertise in building full\-stack applications and deploying scalable, production\-grade software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week. * Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). * Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit). * Location: candidates must be based out of the US, Canada, or WEU countries (Austria, Belgium, France, Germany). **Evaluation Process:*** The application process takes 15\-30 minutes. * Completion of an AI video interview is required.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Chemistry
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Our organization combines synthetic chemistry expertise with robotics and automation: Our long term vision is to build an autonomous synthetic chemistry lab that delivers small\-molecule discovery chemistry services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. We are seeking a Scientist to join our Medicinal Chemistry group and contribute directly to client drug discovery programs. The successful candidate will design and execute multi\-step organic syntheses, propose and evaluate synthetic routes, and generate high\-quality compounds and data in support of hit\-to\-lead and lead optimization campaigns. Beyond bench chemistry, this role plays a key part in our automation mission: the compounds, reactions, and characterization data generated will help build structured, high\-quality training datasets for machine learning models, and the chemist will work directly with AI scientists and roboticists to translate synthetic know\-how into automated and self\-optimizing chemistry platforms. This is a hands\-on role requiring strong technical execution, sound chemical judgment, and comfort operating at the interface of traditional bench chemistry and emerging lab automation. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, plan, and execute multi\-step organic synthesis of target compounds in support of client medicinal chemistry and hit\-to\-lead/lead optimization programs. * Propose and evaluate synthetic routes, including retrosynthetic analysis, selection of viable pathways, and identification of scalable, cost\-effective alternatives. * Perform reaction optimization (yield, selectivity, purity, scalability) and troubleshoot synthetic problems using sound mechanistic reasoning. * Purify and characterize intermediates and final compounds using standard techniques (column chromatography, prep\-HPLC, recrystallization) and analytical methods (LCMS, NMR, HPLC, HRMS). * Accurately and promptly record experimental procedures, observations, and results in electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN) in accordance with company and client documentation standards. * Support scale\-up of key intermediates and final compounds as required by project needs. * Communicate progress, data, and route strategy clearly and regularly to project leaders and, where applicable, directly to client scientists. * Generate clean, well\-structured experimental data (reaction inputs/outputs, conditions, yields, analytical results) suitable for use as high\-quality training data for machine learning and reaction\-prediction models. * Partner closely with AI scientists and roboticists to translate synthetic routes and bench protocols into procedures executable on automated/robotic synthesis platforms, providing chemistry expertise during platform design, testing, and validation. * Provide hands\-on feedback on automated workflows (liquid handling, automated reaction setup, in\-line analytics) and help troubleshoot discrepancies between manual and automated execution of chemistry. * Support iterative improvement of self\-driving lab and automated chemistry capabilities by flagging edge cases, failure modes, and data quality issues encountered at the bench. * Maintain compliance with laboratory safety protocols, chemical hygiene procedures, and proper handling/disposal of hazardous materials. * Manage time and priorities effectively across multiple concurrent projects and client deadlines. * Contribute to continuous improvement of synthetic methods, workflows, and best practices within the chemistry group. **Required Qualifications** * B.S. or M.S. in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline. * 0–3 years of relevant synthetic organic chemistry experience (industry, CRO, or advanced academic/graduate research); internship or co\-op experience considered for entry\-level candidates. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with multi\-step organic synthesis and standard purification techniques. * Working knowledge of retrosynthetic analysis and route design principles. * Proficiency interpreting spectroscopic and analytical data (NMR, LCMS, HPLC) to confirm structure and purity. * Solid understanding of laboratory safety practices and safe handling of reactive/hazardous chemicals. * Strong record\-keeping and documentation habits; experience with ELN systems is a plus. * Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a deadline\-driven environment. * Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to project teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotech industry experience supporting drug discovery programs. * Experience with parallel synthesis, medicinal chemistry SAR exploration, or DMPK\-informed compound design. * Familiarity with chemistry software tools (e.g., ChemDraw, electronic notebooks, reaction database/search tools). * Experience with air\- and moisture\-sensitive chemistry, flow chemistry, or automated/robotic synthesis platforms. * Interest or prior experience in AI/ML\-driven chemistry, cheminformatics, or self\-driving laboratory concepts, and enthusiasm for collaborating with AI scientists and roboticists on lab automation. * Comfort working with structured data entry and an appreciation for how data quality and consistency affect downstream machine learning model performance. * Track record of authorship or contribution to publications, patents, or internal technical reports. **Work Environment / Physical Requirements** * Primarily laboratory\-based role requiring extended periods standing at the bench and working with standard synthetic chemistry equipment. * Regular exposure to laboratory chemicals, solvents, and reagents; strict adherence to PPE and safety protocols is required. * Ability to lift and move laboratory supplies and equipment (up to approximately 25 lbs) as needed. **About Our Organization** We are a contract research organization built at the intersection of medicinal chemistry, robotics, and artificial intelligence. In addition to delivering high\-quality synthesis, route scouting, and scale\-up support to pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients, our chemistry team generates the experimental data that trains our machine learning models and works hand\-in\-hand with our AI scientists and robotics engineers to build automated and self\-optimizing chemistry platforms. Scientists Scientists here gain broad exposure to varied chemotypes and therapeutic areas alongside a front\-row seat to the automation of drug discovery chemistry.

jobs.title: Civil Earthwork - Project Manager
jobs.description: POSITION: **Civil Project Manager** LOCATION: Utah Based. Travel Required PAY: Base Salary $100,000 \- $140,000 (Total package is competitive and comprehensive \+ per diem when based on project that requires travel) **JOB SUMMARY** The Traveling Civil Project Manager leads large earthwork and site development projects from startup through closeout, with a on\-site presence. This role partners closely with the Project Superintendent to drive production, safety, quality, schedule performance, and cost control. Reporting to the Area Manager, the Project Manager is responsible for client interaction, project scheduling, subcontract and vendor management, financial forecasting, and contract administration. Projects may include solar farms, BESS sites, and other large civil site development work. **RESPONSIBILITIES*** Lead project execution from award through closeout, including planning, mobilization, staffing coordination, and project controls setup. * Build and maintain the project schedule, coordinate sequencing with field leadership, and drive timely updates and recovery plans as needed. * Own cost control and forecasting, including monthly projections, production tracking, and proactive management of budget risks and opportunities. * Manage subcontractor and supplier relationships, including scopes, buyout support, procurement coordination, and performance accountability. * Administer the contract, including RFIs, submittals, correspondence, and documentation discipline aligned to project requirements. * Identify, document, price, and negotiate change orders. Ensure potential changes are tracked early and communicated clearly. * Lead project meetings and ensure action items are assigned, followed through, and documented. * Coordinate with the Area Manager on key decisions, project risks, staffing needs, and client strategy. * Partner with the project team to support a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with safety and environmental requirements. * Maintain clear, professional communication with owners and stakeholders. Prepare owner\-facing documentation and updates as required. * Develop and support project engineers and field engineers through mentoring, delegation, and accountability for results. **QUALIFICATIONS*** 4\+ years of heavy civil construction experience, with direct project management or project engineer leadership on earthwork and site development scopes. * Proven ability to create and manage schedules, budgets, and project work plans. While working with the superintendent to support strong field execution. * Experience in contract management and negotiation. * Experience supporting or leading forecasting, change management, and owner communication. * Working knowledge of construction technology tools, including scheduling software. Examples of tools include Primavera P6, Procore, Excel, HCSS Products or other similar platforms. * Strong understanding of civil construction means and methods, including mass grading, utilities, and site logistics. * Ability to lead a project team, run meetings, and coordinate across field leadership, subcontractors, and vendors. * Willingness to travel and remain onsite for the duration of assigned projects. * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred. Equivalent heavy civil experience will be considered. * Maintain an insurable driving record. To learn more about WW Clyde and our work, visit **wwclyde.net.*** *As part of our hiring process, all candidates are subject to a comprehensive background check. Please note that our company maintains a strict policy regarding certain convictions. Applicants with a DUI or felony conviction may not meet eligibility requirements for employment in this position. Offer/ Start Date is contingent upon a successful background check and preemployment drug screen (including THC)* WW Clyde is an "Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action/PWDNET" Employer
